quran_text_all_rows.arabic_uthmani: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ

سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَسْرَىٰ بِعَبْدِهِۦ لَيْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ إِلَى ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْأَقْصَا ٱلَّذِى بَٰرَكْنَا حَوْلَهُۥ لِنُرِيَهُۥ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَآ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
وَءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ هُدًۭى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ مِن دُونِى وَكِيلًۭا
ذُرِّيَّةَ مَنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَبْدًۭا شَكُورًۭا
وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَتُفْسِدُنَّ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلَتَعْلُنَّ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ أُولَىٰهُمَا بَعَثْنَا عَلَيْكُمْ عِبَادًۭا لَّنَآ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ فَجَاسُوا۟ خِلَٰلَ ٱلدِّيَارِ ۚ وَكَانَ وَعْدًۭا مَّفْعُولًۭا
ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلْكَرَّةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَمْدَدْنَٰكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ أَكْثَرَ نَفِيرًا

إِنْ أَحْسَنتُمْ أَحْسَنتُمْ لِأَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ وَإِنْ أَسَأْتُمْ فَلَهَا ۚ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لِيَسُۥٓـُٔوا۟ وُجُوهَكُمْ وَلِيَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ كَمَا دَخَلُوهُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ وَلِيُتَبِّرُوا۟ مَا عَلَوْا۟ تَتْبِيرًا
عَسَىٰ رَبُّكُمْ أَن يَرْحَمَكُمْ ۚ وَإِنْ عُدتُّمْ عُدْنَا ۘ وَجَعَلْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ حَصِيرًا
إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَهْدِى لِلَّتِى هِىَ أَقْوَمُ وَيُبَشِّرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أَنَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
وَيَدْعُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ بِٱلشَّرِّ دُعَآءَهُۥ بِٱلْخَيْرِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَجُولًۭا

وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ءَايَتَيْنِ ۖ فَمَحَوْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَجَعَلْنَآ ءَايَةَ ٱلنَّهَارِ مُبْصِرَةًۭ لِّتَبْتَغُوا۟ فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَلِتَعْلَمُوا۟ عَدَدَ ٱلسِّنِينَ وَٱلْحِسَابَ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍۢ فَصَّلْنَٰهُ تَفْصِيلًۭا
وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلْزَمْنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِى عُنُقِهِۦ ۖ وَنُخْرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبًۭا يَلْقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
ٱقْرَأْ كِتَٰبَكَ كَفَىٰ بِنَفْسِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكَ حَسِيبًۭا
مَّنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَإِنَّمَا يَضِلُّ عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ وَمَا كُنَّا مُعَذِّبِينَ حَتَّىٰ نَبْعَثَ رَسُولًۭا
وَإِذَآ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نُّهْلِكَ قَرْيَةً أَمَرْنَا مُتْرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُوا۟ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيْهَا ٱلْقَوْلُ فَدَمَّرْنَٰهَا تَدْمِيرًۭا
وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ نُوحٍۢ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا
مَّن كَانَ يُرِيدُ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ عَجَّلْنَا لَهُۥ فِيهَا مَا نَشَآءُ لِمَن نُّرِيدُ ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَىٰهَا مَذْمُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًۭا
وَمَنْ أَرَادَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَسَعَىٰ لَهَا سَعْيَهَا وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ سَعْيُهُم مَّشْكُورًۭا
كُلًّۭا نُّمِدُّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَهَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مِنْ عَطَآءِ رَبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ عَطَآءُ رَبِّكَ مَحْظُورًا
ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ أَكْبَرُ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ وَأَكْبَرُ تَفْضِيلًۭا
لَّا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقْعُدَ مَذْمُومًۭا مَّخْذُولًۭا

۞ وَقَضَىٰ رَبُّكَ أَلَّا تَعْبُدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ وَبِٱلْوَٰلِدَيْنِ إِحْسَٰنًا ۚ إِمَّا يَبْلُغَنَّ عِندَكَ ٱلْكِبَرَ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَوْ كِلَاهُمَا فَلَا تَقُل لَّهُمَآ أُفٍّۢ وَلَا تَنْهَرْهُمَا وَقُل لَّهُمَا قَوْلًۭا كَرِيمًۭا
وَٱخْفِضْ لَهُمَا جَنَاحَ ٱلذُّلِّ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَةِ وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا كَمَا رَبَّيَانِى صَغِيرًۭا
رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا فِى نُفُوسِكُمْ ۚ إِن تَكُونُوا۟ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلْأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورًۭا
وَءَاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَلَا تُبَذِّرْ تَبْذِيرًا
إِنَّ ٱلْمُبَذِّرِينَ كَانُوٓا۟ إِخْوَٰنَ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ لِرَبِّهِۦ كَفُورًۭا
وَإِمَّا تُعْرِضَنَّ عَنْهُمُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ رَحْمَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ تَرْجُوهَا فَقُل لَّهُمْ قَوْلًۭا مَّيْسُورًۭا
وَلَا تَجْعَلْ يَدَكَ مَغْلُولَةً إِلَىٰ عُنُقِكَ وَلَا تَبْسُطْهَا كُلَّ ٱلْبَسْطِ فَتَقْعُدَ مَلُومًۭا مَّحْسُورًا
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا
وَلَا تَقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَوْلَٰدَكُمْ خَشْيَةَ إِمْلَٰقٍۢ ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُهُمْ وَإِيَّاكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ قَتْلَهُمْ كَانَ خِطْـًۭٔا كَبِيرًۭا
وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ ٱلزِّنَىٰٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَٰحِشَةًۭ وَسَآءَ سَبِيلًۭا
وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَن قُتِلَ مَظْلُومًۭا فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا لِوَلِيِّهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًۭا فَلَا يُسْرِف فِّى ٱلْقَتْلِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مَنصُورًۭا
وَلَا تَقْرَبُوا۟ مَالَ ٱلْيَتِيمِ إِلَّا بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ حَتَّىٰ يَبْلُغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَوْفُوا۟ بِٱلْعَهْدِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَهْدَ كَانَ مَسْـُٔولًۭا
وَأَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ إِذَا كِلْتُمْ وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَحْسَنُ تَأْوِيلًۭا
وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْبَصَرَ وَٱلْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْـُٔولًۭا
وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًۭا
كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ كَانَ سَيِّئُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّكَ مَكْرُوهًۭا
ذَٰلِكَ مِمَّآ أَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ رَبُّكَ مِنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةِ ۗ وَلَا تَجْعَلْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتُلْقَىٰ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَلُومًۭا مَّدْحُورًا
أَفَأَصْفَىٰكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوْلًا عَظِيمًۭا
وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ وَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًۭا
قُل لَّوْ كَانَ مَعَهُۥٓ ءَالِهَةٌۭ كَمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذًۭا لَّٱبْتَغَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ سَبِيلًۭا
سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ عُلُوًّۭا كَبِيرًۭا
تُسَبِّحُ لَهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ ٱلسَّبْعُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا يُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَلَٰكِن لَّا تَفْقَهُونَ تَسْبِيحَهُمْ ۗ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ حَلِيمًا غَفُورًۭا
وَإِذَا قَرَأْتَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ جَعَلْنَا بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ حِجَابًۭا مَّسْتُورًۭا
وَجَعَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ أَكِنَّةً أَن يَفْقَهُوهُ وَفِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَقْرًۭا ۚ وَإِذَا ذَكَرْتَ رَبَّكَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَلَّوْا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَٰرِهِمْ نُفُورًۭا
نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَسْتَمِعُونَ بِهِۦٓ إِذْ يَسْتَمِعُونَ إِلَيْكَ وَإِذْ هُمْ نَجْوَىٰٓ إِذْ يَقُولُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًۭا مَّسْحُورًا
ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًۭا
وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًۭا جَدِيدًۭا
۞ قُلْ كُونُوا۟ حِجَارَةً أَوْ حَدِيدًا

أَوْ خَلْقًۭا مِّمَّا يَكْبُرُ فِى صُدُورِكُمْ ۚ فَسَيَقُولُونَ مَن يُعِيدُنَا ۖ قُلِ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَكُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۚ فَسَيُنْغِضُونَ إِلَيْكَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هُوَ ۖ قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ قَرِيبًۭا
يَوْمَ يَدْعُوكُمْ فَتَسْتَجِيبُونَ بِحَمْدِهِۦ وَتَظُنُّونَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
وَقُل لِّعِبَادِى يَقُولُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ يَنزَغُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوًّۭا مُّبِينًۭا
رَّبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ ۖ إِن يَشَأْ يَرْحَمْكُمْ أَوْ إِن يَشَأْ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ ۚ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَكِيلًۭا
وَرَبُّكَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَلَقَدْ فَضَّلْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ زَبُورًۭا
قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ زَعَمْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَلَا يَمْلِكُونَ كَشْفَ ٱلضُّرِّ عَنكُمْ وَلَا تَحْوِيلًا
أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ يَبْتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلْوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَيَرْجُونَ رَحْمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحْذُورًۭا
وَإِن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا نَحْنُ مُهْلِكُوهَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَوْ مُعَذِّبُوهَا عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًۭا ۚ كَانَ ذَٰلِكَ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَسْطُورًۭا
وَمَا مَنَعَنَآ أَن نُّرْسِلَ بِٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِلَّآ أَن كَذَّبَ بِهَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ ۚ وَءَاتَيْنَا ثَمُودَ ٱلنَّاقَةَ مُبْصِرَةًۭ فَظَلَمُوا۟ بِهَا ۚ وَمَا نُرْسِلُ بِٱلْءَايَٰتِ إِلَّا تَخْوِيفًۭا

وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لَكَ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ أَحَاطَ بِٱلنَّاسِ ۚ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا ٱلرُّءْيَا ٱلَّتِىٓ أَرَيْنَٰكَ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّجَرَةَ ٱلْمَلْعُونَةَ فِى ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ وَنُخَوِّفُهُمْ فَمَا يَزِيدُهُمْ إِلَّا طُغْيَٰنًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ قَالَ ءَأَسْجُدُ لِمَنْ خَلَقْتَ طِينًۭا
قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
قَالَ ٱذْهَبْ فَمَن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ فَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ جَزَآؤُكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ مَّوْفُورًۭا
وَٱسْتَفْزِزْ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتَ مِنْهُم بِصَوْتِكَ وَأَجْلِبْ عَلَيْهِم بِخَيْلِكَ وَرَجِلِكَ وَشَارِكْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَٰدِ وَعِدْهُمْ ۚ وَمَا يَعِدُهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا
إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ وَكِيلًۭا
رَّبُّكُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُزْجِى لَكُمُ ٱلْفُلْكَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِكُمْ رَحِيمًۭا
وَإِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ ضَلَّ مَن تَدْعُونَ إِلَّآ إِيَّاهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا نَجَّىٰكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْبَرِّ أَعْرَضْتُمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ كَفُورًا
أَفَأَمِنتُمْ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلْبَرِّ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ وَكِيلًا
أَمْ أَمِنتُمْ أَن يُعِيدَكُمْ فِيهِ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ فَيُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ قَاصِفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلرِّيحِ فَيُغْرِقَكُم بِمَا كَفَرْتُمْ ۙ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُوا۟ لَكُمْ عَلَيْنَا بِهِۦ تَبِيعًۭا
۞ وَلَقَدْ كَرَّمْنَا بَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ وَحَمَلْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّمَّنْ خَلَقْنَا تَفْضِيلًۭا
يَوْمَ نَدْعُوا۟ كُلَّ أُنَاسٍۭ بِإِمَٰمِهِمْ ۖ فَمَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَقْرَءُونَ كِتَٰبَهُمْ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ فَتِيلًۭا
وَمَن كَانَ فِى هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَعْمَىٰ فَهُوَ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَعْمَىٰ وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًۭا
وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَفْتِنُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ لِتَفْتَرِىَ عَلَيْنَا غَيْرَهُۥ ۖ وَإِذًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذُوكَ خَلِيلًۭا
وَلَوْلَآ أَن ثَبَّتْنَٰكَ لَقَدْ كِدتَّ تَرْكَنُ إِلَيْهِمْ شَيْـًۭٔا قَلِيلًا
إِذًۭا لَّأَذَقْنَٰكَ ضِعْفَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعْفَ ٱلْمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيْنَا نَصِيرًۭا
وَإِن كَادُوا۟ لَيَسْتَفِزُّونَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيُخْرِجُوكَ مِنْهَا ۖ وَإِذًۭا لَّا يَلْبَثُونَ خِلَٰفَكَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
سُنَّةَ مَن قَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَا ۖ وَلَا تَجِدُ لِسُنَّتِنَا تَحْوِيلًا
أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمْسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَقُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ ۖ إِنَّ قُرْءَانَ ٱلْفَجْرِ كَانَ مَشْهُودًۭا
وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَتَهَجَّدْ بِهِۦ نَافِلَةًۭ لَّكَ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَبْعَثَكَ رَبُّكَ مَقَامًۭا مَّحْمُودًۭا
وَقُل رَّبِّ أَدْخِلْنِى مُدْخَلَ صِدْقٍۢ وَأَخْرِجْنِى مُخْرَجَ صِدْقٍۢ وَٱجْعَل لِّى مِن لَّدُنكَ سُلْطَٰنًۭا نَّصِيرًۭا
وَقُلْ جَآءَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَزَهَقَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْبَٰطِلَ كَانَ زَهُوقًۭا
وَنُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَا هُوَ شِفَآءٌۭ وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۙ وَلَا يَزِيدُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
وَإِذَآ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ أَعْرَضَ وَنَـَٔا بِجَانِبِهِۦ ۖ وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ كَانَ يَـُٔوسًۭا
قُلْ كُلٌّۭ يَعْمَلُ عَلَىٰ شَاكِلَتِهِۦ فَرَبُّكُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ هُوَ أَهْدَىٰ سَبِيلًۭا
وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ ٱلرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّى وَمَآ أُوتِيتُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
وَلَئِن شِئْنَا لَنَذْهَبَنَّ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ بِهِۦ عَلَيْنَا وَكِيلًا
إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّ فَضْلَهُۥ كَانَ عَلَيْكَ كَبِيرًۭا
قُل لَّئِنِ ٱجْتَمَعَتِ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَأْتُوا۟ بِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ لَا يَأْتُونَ بِمِثْلِهِۦ وَلَوْ كَانَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍۢ ظَهِيرًۭا
وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
وَقَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْمِنَ لَكَ حَتَّىٰ تَفْجُرَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ يَنۢبُوعًا
أَوْ تَكُونَ لَكَ جَنَّةٌۭ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَعِنَبٍۢ فَتُفَجِّرَ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرَ خِلَٰلَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
أَوْ تُسْقِطَ ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَمَا زَعَمْتَ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا أَوْ تَأْتِىَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ قَبِيلًا

أَوْ يَكُونَ لَكَ بَيْتٌۭ مِّن زُخْرُفٍ أَوْ تَرْقَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَلَن نُّؤْمِنَ لِرُقِيِّكَ حَتَّىٰ تُنَزِّلَ عَلَيْنَا كِتَٰبًۭا نَّقْرَؤُهُۥ ۗ قُلْ سُبْحَانَ رَبِّى هَلْ كُنتُ إِلَّا بَشَرًۭا رَّسُولًۭا
وَمَا مَنَعَ ٱلنَّاسَ أَن يُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَبَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ بَشَرًۭا رَّسُولًۭا
قُل لَّوْ كَانَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَلَٰٓئِكَةٌۭ يَمْشُونَ مُطْمَئِنِّينَ لَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَلَكًۭا رَّسُولًۭا
قُلْ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۢا بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًۢا بَصِيرًۭا

وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَهُوَ ٱلْمُهْتَدِ ۖ وَمَن يُضْلِلْ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ وَنَحْشُرُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ عُمْيًۭا وَبُكْمًۭا وَصُمًّۭا ۖ مَّأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ كُلَّمَا خَبَتْ زِدْنَٰهُمْ سَعِيرًۭا
ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم بِأَنَّهُمْ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا وَرُفَٰتًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ خَلْقًۭا جَدِيدًا
۞ أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ قَادِرٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَهُمْ أَجَلًۭا لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ فَأَبَى ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
قُل لَّوْ أَنتُمْ تَمْلِكُونَ خَزَآئِنَ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّأَمْسَكْتُمْ خَشْيَةَ ٱلْإِنفَاقِ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ قَتُورًۭا
وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
قَالَ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَآ أَنزَلَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ بَصَآئِرَ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَٰفِرْعَوْنُ مَثْبُورًۭا
فَأَرَادَ أَن يَسْتَفِزَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ جَمِيعًۭا
وَقُلْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ لِبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱسْكُنُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ جِئْنَا بِكُمْ لَفِيفًۭا
وَبِٱلْحَقِّ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ وَبِٱلْحَقِّ نَزَلَ ۗ وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
وَقُرْءَانًۭا فَرَقْنَٰهُ لِتَقْرَأَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ عَلَىٰ مُكْثٍۢ وَنَزَّلْنَٰهُ تَنزِيلًۭا
قُلْ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ أَوْ لَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦٓ إِذَا يُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ يَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ سُجَّدًۭا
وَيَقُولُونَ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفْعُولًۭا
وَيَخِرُّونَ لِلْأَذْقَانِ يَبْكُونَ وَيَزِيدُهُمْ خُشُوعًۭا ۩
قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ ۖ أَيًّۭا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًۭا
وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَمْ يَتَّخِذْ وَلَدًۭا وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ شَرِيكٌۭ فِى ٱلْمُلْكِ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ وَلِىٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلذُّلِّ ۖ وَكَبِّرْهُ تَكْبِيرًۢا

parent_channels.name: P1 (17:1-22): Directed Passage Through Bounded Fields

subchannels.name: Night Transit Between Sanctuaries
subchannels.scene_or_process: A servant is carried at night from one protected worship-place to a remote one, through a blessed surrounding field, so that signs can be made visible.
subchannels.active_motifs: night travel (`quranic:root_000702:B001/m01`); night darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); worship-place (`quranic:root_000675:B002/m01`); protected sanctuary (`quranic:root_000313:B003/m01`); remote limit (`quranic:root_001235:B001/m01`); surrounding side (`quranic:root_000373:B004/m01`); showing and disclosure (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The movement is not bare displacement. Night supplies the setting, the two worship-places supply departure and arrival, sanctuary and remoteness define the endpoints, and the blessed surround becomes the field in which disclosure occurs. The journey is therefore a guided passage whose destination is perceptual as well as spatial.

subchannels.name: Routed Current and Receiving Basin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water is led through a channel, flows into a fixed pool, is reinforced by another current, and can be circulated by a lifting device.
subchannels.active_motifs: routed watercourse (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); running current (`quranic:root_000702:B002/m01`); fixed pool (`quranic:root_000109:B003/m01`); water collected in a depression (`quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`); gathered water (`quranic:root_001292:B003/m01`); replenishing flow (`quranic:root_001407:B003/m01`); river channel (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); water-lifting mechanism (`quranic:root_000373:B016/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The lexical field converts directed passage into fluid conveyance. An incoming stream is given a course, received in a basin, augmented by a second supply, and kept moving by a turning apparatus. This makes the opening journey resonate as controlled transmission into a prepared sacred surround rather than motion through undifferentiated space.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A directed movement crosses distance while boundaries, stations, and a receiving field give the movement its intelligible course.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:1 anchors the night journey in `أسرى`, `ليلا`, `المسجد الحرام`, `المسجد الأقصى`, `حوله`, and `لنريه`, while 17:2-12 supply local lexical material for channels, inflow, collection, and circulation.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The sacred itinerary materializes as a hydraulic system in which a current is routed, collected, replenished, and turned around a fixed basin.

parent_channels.name: P1 (17:1-22): Incursion, Counterturn, and Enclosure

subchannels.name: Penetration Through the Dwellings
subchannels.scene_or_process: A threatened appointment activates a dispatched force that searches through gaps, enters inhabited space, and shatters what it overtakes.
subchannels.active_motifs: threatening promise (`quranic:root_001662:B002/m01`); bounded appointment (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); dispatched agent (`quranic:root_000129:B002/m01`); collective surge (`quranic:root_000129:B004/m01`); overpowering force (`quranic:root_000079:B001/m01`); penetration through dwellings (`quranic:root_000277:B001/m01`); trampling mixture with a place (`quranic:root_000277:B003/m01`); interstitial opening (`quranic:root_000435:B001/m01`); entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); annihilating breakage (`quranic:root_000174:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene has a precise assault geometry. The promise fixes the activation point; dispatch and force provide the agents; gaps and interiors supply the route; penetration becomes physical mixture with the occupied place; and breakage is the outcome. The latent spatial mechanics intensify the surface account of invasion.

subchannels.name: Counterturn Reinforced Into a Host
subchannels.scene_or_process: Defeated movement is turned back, reinforced with connected supplies, and expanded into a numerous mobilized body.
subchannels.active_motifs: restoration to a former position (`quranic:root_000555:B001/m01`); repeated turn (`quranic:root_001292:B001/m01`); connected reinforcement (`quranic:root_001407:B002/m01`); accumulated wealth (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); lineage and descendants (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); numerical growth (`quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`); rivalry by number (`quranic:root_001286:B002/m01`); rising to war or aid (`quranic:root_001532:B002/m01`); supporting host (`quranic:root_001532:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The counterstroke is assembled rather than instantaneous. Return restores position, extension connects new material to the recovered body, descendants and wealth thicken it, and numerical growth becomes a host capable of aid or war. Recurrence thus acquires logistical substance.

subchannels.name: Relapse Closed by Confinement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mercy opens after an earlier cycle, but habitual return to offense triggers a corresponding return and closes the offenders inside an encompassing restraint.
subchannels.active_motifs: return after departure (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); ingrained recurrence (`quranic:root_001058:B004/m01`); mercy and tenderness (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); covering the truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); confinement and encirclement (`quranic:root_000328:B004/m01`); woven enclosure (`quranic:root_000328:B008/m01`); transformation into a state (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Return is both event and habit. Mercy leaves the cycle open, but renewed covering produces a matched counter-return, after which `حصيرا` holds together the senses of encircling prison and woven mat. The final state is a recurrence made spatially inescapable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Collective force moves through openings, meets a reversal, and is finally contained by the consequences of repeated return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:4-8 narrate two promised incursions, penetration of dwellings, a restored counterturn, renewed destruction, mercy, relapse, and confinement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Military recurrence is rendered through apertures, repeated rotations, gathered force, and a woven or enclosing final boundary.

parent_channels.name: P1 (17:1-22): Inscription, Exposure, and Nontransferable Account

subchannels.name: The Alternating Sky as Calendar Ledger
subchannels.scene_or_process: Darkness and daylight are differentiated by erasure and visibility, allowing count, calendrical recurrence, and articulated division.
subchannels.active_motifs: night darkness (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); daylight opening (`quranic:root_001559:B002/m01`); manifest sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); erasure of trace (`quranic:root_001404:B001/m01`); visual perception (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); enumeration (`quranic:root_000989:B001/m01`); yearly cycle (`quranic:root_000751:B008/m01`); reckoning (`quranic:root_000318:B001/m01`); articulated differentiation (`quranic:root_001159:B013/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The sky works as a legible counting surface. One sign is effaced and the other exposed; their alternation produces enumerable years; and differentiation turns the continuous flow of time into articulated units. Cosmic order is therefore presented as an accounting technology.

subchannels.name: The Fastened Dossier Opened to Its Bearer
subchannels.scene_or_process: A personal sign is fixed at the neck, brought out from concealment, opened as a written object, encountered, and read.
subchannels.active_motifs: judicial fastening (`quranic:root_001354:B002/m01`); bodily attachment (`quranic:root_001354:B005/m01`); bird and flight (`quranic:root_000962:B001/m01`); neck (`quranic:root_001053:B001/m01`); extraction from concealment (`quranic:root_000400:B002/m01`); joined written object (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); written letters (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); published document (`quranic:root_001503:B009/m01`); encounter (`quranic:root_001372:B004/m01`); reading aloud (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The account moves through a full documentary process: fastening, bodily custody, extraction, opening, encounter, and recitation. The omen is not left airborne; it becomes a dossier carried at the neck and unfolded before the very person whose acts it records.

subchannels.name: A Load That Cannot Change Bearers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Guidance or loss accrues to the acting self, while the burden remains with its bearer until a message has first been dispatched.
subchannels.active_motifs: the self as the thing itself (`quranic:root_001533:B012/m01`); heavy burden (`quranic:root_001643:B002/m01`); refuge sought under load (`quranic:root_001643:B001/m01`); gentle route-guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); deviation from the intended course (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); lost object (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); dispatched messenger (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); sufficiency in undertaking an account (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Route and load form complementary moral mechanics. Guidance keeps the self on course; deviation loses the course; the resulting burden cannot be transferred to another carrier. Dispatch of a messenger precedes penalty, so liability is personal but not uninformed.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Marks are differentiated, attached, unfolded, and read so that each agent encounters an account that cannot be shifted elsewhere.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:12-15 move from cosmic signs and calculation to the attached personal record, its publication and reading, and the rule that no bearer carries another's burden.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Time becomes a marked ledger, the record becomes a bodily fastening that opens like material, and moral agency becomes a load with no transferable carrier.

parent_channels.name: P1 (17:1-22): Desire, Effort, and Apportioned Outcome

subchannels.name: The Hasty Call That Misnames Harm as Good
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech draws an object toward the caller before discernment has separated benefit from injury.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); invocation of descending harm (`quranic:root_000478:B004/m01`); injurious evil (`quranic:root_000787:B001/m01`); beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`); acceleration and premature advance (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); provision demanded in advance (`quranic:root_000987:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The call is causative: it seeks to pull an outcome near. Haste collapses the distinction between good and harm, and the latent image of advance provision makes the error one of demanding receipt before value has been judged.

subchannels.name: Two Desired Horizons and Their Work
subchannels.scene_or_process: Will selects a horizon, haste pursues the near one, while deliberate striving toward the later one joins motion, work, trust, and acknowledged yield.
subchannels.active_motifs: will and intention (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); searching for a desired object (`quranic:root_000610:B003/m01`); accelerated advance (`quranic:root_000987:B001/m01`); purposive movement (`quranic:root_000709:B001/m01`); work and acquisition (`quranic:root_000709:B002/m01`); labor toward emancipation (`quranic:root_000709:B005/m01`); settled trust (`quranic:root_000054:B001/m01`); acknowledged benefit (`quranic:root_000810:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The opposition is not simply between two objects. The near horizon solicits acceleration, whereas the later horizon requires fitted striving and work. The emancipation sense of `سعي` usefully pressures the reading: disciplined effort is a movement out of bondage to immediacy.

subchannels.name: Connected Supply Distributed by Degree
subchannels.scene_or_process: Both groups receive an extending supply, but its shares remain unblocked and are differentiated into steps and ranks.
subchannels.active_motifs: connected increase and support (`quranic:root_001407:B002/m01`); handing over a gift (`quranic:root_001028:B002/m01`); enclosure and prohibition (`quranic:root_000338:B002/m01`); bestowed excellence (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); rank and merit (`quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`); partition into portions (`quranic:root_000133:B001/m01`); stepwise ascent (`quranic:root_000468:B003/m01`); comparison until two sides are measured (`quranic:root_001520:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Provision is pictured as an extension that reaches both orientations. It is not enclosed, yet it is not flat: portions are compared and arranged step by step. The lexical mechanics distinguish unrestricted flow from equal outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: An inward aim becomes motion and work, while the eventual share is extended, limited, or ranked by an allocator beyond the worker.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:11 and 17:18-21 contrast impulsive request, pursuit of the immediate or the afterlife, divinely extended gifts, and differentiated ranks.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Desire appears as bodily haste and route choice, striving carries an emancipation sense, and allotment behaves like a connected supply distributed by degree.

parent_channels.name: P1 (17:1-22): Civic Ripening Into Collapse

subchannels.name: Internal Release Becomes External Ruin
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ease releases its holders from restraint, transgression breaks out of its covering, an obligation fixes, and the settlement is eradicated.
subchannels.active_motifs: abundance that releases its possessor (`quranic:root_000179:B001/m01`); ripe fruit leaving its shell (`quranic:root_001156:B002/m01`); binding entitlement becoming due (`quranic:root_000347:B002/m01`); a thing's indicative utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B014/m01`); comprehensive destruction (`quranic:root_000487:B002/m01`); falling into extinction (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The city fails from the inside outward. Affluence loosens restraint; `فسق` gives that release the concrete form of ripe matter breaking its husk; the word then registers what has become due; and destruction externalizes the matured condition.

subchannels.name: The Historical Tail Remains Legible
subchannels.scene_or_process: Generations are linked in temporal cohorts, but destruction cuts them off while their trailing acts remain available to interior knowledge and sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: a cohort bound in one age (`quranic:root_001221:B005/m01`); remoteness as ruin or curse (`quranic:root_000131:B004/m01`); guilt (`quranic:root_000521:B001/m01`); the trailing end of a thing (`quranic:root_000521:B002/m01`); knowledge of an interior (`quranic:root_000387:B001/m01`); inward discernment (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); sufficiency in carrying a matter through (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: A generation is a linked temporal body. Its disappearance does not erase its tail: `ذنب` joins culpability to what trails behind, while interior knowledge and sight make that remainder legible. Historical ruin therefore leaves an accountable residue rather than a blank interval.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A collective interior condition ripens until a binding declaration becomes visible in ruin and leaves a trace across generations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:16-17 connect affluent transgression, the word becoming due, total destruction, earlier generations, sins, and divine interior knowledge and sight.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Transgression is an object escaping its shell, the decisive word behaves like a diagnostic sign, and sin extends as a trailing remainder through a linked historical series.

parent_channels.name: P2 (17:23-39): Care Folded Back Across Generations

subchannels.name: Speech at the Threshold of Old Age
subchannels.scene_or_process: When parents reach advanced age in the child's presence, disgust and forceful rebuke are withheld and replaced by speech that confers honor.
subchannels.active_motifs: parents through birth (`quranic:root_001683:B002/m01`); reaching an endpoint (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); old age (`quranic:root_001281:B004/m01`); sound of disgust (`quranic:root_000039:B001/m01`); forceful verbal rebuke (`quranic:root_001559:B004/m01`); spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); honorable generosity (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Aging creates a threshold at which power has reversed. The smallest expulsion of disgust and the larger force of rebuke are both blocked; speech instead becomes an act of conferring worth. Care is thus first regulated at the mouth.

subchannels.name: The Lowered Wing of Repaid Nurture
subchannels.scene_or_process: The stronger party bends down, spreads a protective side, softens without humiliation, and repays the nurture once given to a small child.
subchannels.active_motifs: descent from height (`quranic:root_000426:B001/m01`); gentleness and ease (`quranic:root_000426:B002/m01`); wing as side, hand, and shelter (`quranic:root_000263:B002/m01`); bodily leaning and support (`quranic:root_000263:B007/m01`); softness without abasement (`quranic:root_000519:B002/m01`); mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); nourishment and growth (`quranic:root_000537:B005/m01`); childhood smallness (`quranic:root_000865:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The metaphor is a complete care posture. Height is relinquished, the side becomes shelter, and softness makes the body available as support. Because nurture and smallness are also active, the movement folds earlier parental care back toward its source.

subchannels.name: Interior Return Under a Protective Cover
subchannels.scene_or_process: Inner intention is known, reform redirects it, return brings it home, and forgiveness covers the returning person from the consequence of fault.
subchannels.active_motifs: inner self and deliberation (`quranic:root_001533:B013/m01`); disclosure to knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); repair against corruption (`quranic:root_000876:B001/m01`); homeward return (`quranic:root_000065:B001/m01`); protective covering of fault (`quranic:root_001096:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The scene moves beneath outward conduct. What lies in the self is exposed to knowledge; reform changes its direction; return closes the distance; and forgiveness supplies a cover that protects rather than conceals ongoing corruption.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Care received in weakness returns when age reverses dependency, moving from controlled speech to lowered posture and inward return.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:23-25 command good treatment of aging parents, lowered merciful bearing, remembrance of upbringing in childhood, and forgiveness for those who return.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Filial mercy takes avian form as a lowered wing, harsh speech is a forceful verbal outburst, and repentance is a homeward bodily recurrence covered against injury.

parent_channels.name: P2 (17:23-39): Resource Circulation Between Scattering and Throttling

subchannels.name: Rightful Distribution Versus Seedlike Dissipation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A due share moves toward kin, the needy, and the traveler; waste instead breaks resources into scattered particles and binds the waster to remote rebellion.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving and transfer (`quranic:root_000009:B002/m01`); kinship by nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B003/m01`); owned entitlement (`quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`); dependent need (`quranic:root_000726:B006/m01`); people of the road (`quranic:root_000672:B002/m01`); scattering seed (`quranic:root_000098:B001/m01`); dissipating wealth (`quranic:root_000098:B003/m01`); tether of brotherhood (`quranic:root_000020:B002/m01`); remoteness and severance (`quranic:root_000796:B001/m01`); covering a received favor (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Giving preserves relation: each share reaches a named claim. Waste destroys relation by scattering resources like seed with no field or harvest. The brother-tether then reveals the paradox: dissipation severs social obligations while binding the spender to the distant rebel who covers the source of the gift.

subchannels.name: The Hand Chained to the Neck
subchannels.scene_or_process: The giving limb is either collared against movement or extended without limit, producing immobility at one extreme and exposed exhaustion at the other.
subchannels.active_motifs: hand as limb (`quranic:root_001693:B001/m01`); hand as transfer (`quranic:root_001693:B007/m01`); collar that binds an organ (`quranic:root_001102:B006/m01`); neck (`quranic:root_001053:B001/m01`); spreading against contraction (`quranic:root_000116:B001/m01`); unrestricted hand-extension (`quranic:root_000116:B004/m01`); loss of protection (`quranic:root_000320:B002/m01`); exhausted power (`quranic:root_000320:B003/m01`); sitting back from action (`quranic:root_001244:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The verse supplies a stable bodily mechanism for economic conduct. A collar prevents the hand from reaching outward; total extension strips the giver of cover and strength. Both extremes end in seated incapacity, so generosity requires mobile but bounded reach.

subchannels.name: Provision Through a Variable Aperture
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sustenance is allotted, widened into abundance, or narrowed to a measured share by one who knows the recipients.
subchannels.active_motifs: apportioned gift (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); nourishing ration (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); breadth and abundance (`quranic:root_000116:B003/m01`); measured limit (`quranic:root_001205:B001/m01`); narrowing to a small measure (`quranic:root_001205:B004/m01`); fitting a midpoint (`quranic:root_001205:B006/m01`); knowledge of the interior (`quranic:root_000387:B001/m01`); visual oversight (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Expansion and constriction are not opposed sources; they are settings of one distributive mechanism. Provision can open into breadth or pass through a reduced measure, while knowledge and sight keep calibration attached to actual recipients.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material provision must reach its proper recipients without being atomized in waste, immobilized by restraint, or released without measure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:26-31 move from kin-right and aid to the traveler, through waste and hand-restraint, to divinely expanded or narrowed provision and fear of poverty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Waste becomes seed scattered without cultivation, miserliness becomes a hand chained to the neck, and provision becomes a flow widened or constricted to a measured aperture.

parent_channels.name: P2 (17:23-39): Protected Thresholds Around Vulnerable Life and Property

subchannels.name: Child Survival Against Anticipated Scarcity
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fear projects future poverty, but provision is already assigned, so killing the newly dependent life becomes both missed judgment and culpable act.
subchannels.active_motifs: child of recent birth (`quranic:root_001683:B004/m01`); taking life (`quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`); fearful anticipation (`quranic:root_000413:B001/m01`); hand stripped of wealth (`quranic:root_001443:B002/m01`); nourishing provision (`quranic:root_000560:B002/m01`); missing the correct mark (`quranic:root_000420:B001/m01`); culpable error (`quranic:root_000420:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The act is driven by an imagined future in which the hand will be bare. The provision motif interrupts that projection by locating nourishment outside the killer's exclusive control. Killing therefore mistakes anticipated lack for settled reality and compounds error into guilt.

subchannels.name: The Forbidden Approach-Zone
subchannels.scene_or_process: A boundary is placed before sexual violation so that the prohibited process is stopped at approach rather than only at completion.
subchannels.active_motifs: nearing and contact (`quranic:root_001212:B007/m01`); illicit intercourse (`quranic:root_000648:B001/m01`); conspicuous ugliness (`quranic:root_001134:B001/m01`); exceeding measure (`quranic:root_001134:B002/m01`); harmful outcome (`quranic:root_000755:B002/m01`); extended route (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The operative unit is not only the final act but the route of approach. Nearing becomes participation in a process whose visible ugliness consists in exceeding measure; the bad path names the whole trajectory that leads into it.

subchannels.name: Delegated Retaliation Under a Stop
subchannels.scene_or_process: Protected life may not be taken without right; when it is, authority passes to a close custodian, but that authority is bounded against excess.
subchannels.active_motifs: taking life (`quranic:root_001200:B001/m01`); sacred prohibition (`quranic:root_000313:B001/m01`); owned right (`quranic:root_000347:B003/m01`); demand for redress (`quranic:root_000967:B003/m01`); close custodian (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); delegated capacity (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); crossing the limit (`quranic:root_000699:B001/m01`); vindication of the wronged (`quranic:root_001510:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The killing creates a legal transfer, not an unrestricted reversal. Right and authority move to the nearest custodian, while the prohibition on excess prevents redress from reproducing the original violation. Support belongs to bounded vindication.

subchannels.name: Entrusted Property Until Maturity
subchannels.scene_or_process: The property of one cut off from a protector remains under guarded proximity until bodily maturity, after which a preserved covenant must be fulfilled and answered for.
subchannels.active_motifs: child cut off from a guardian (`quranic:root_001692:B001/m01`); accumulated property (`quranic:root_001457:B001/m01`); beneficial excellence (`quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`); arrival at maturity (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); adult strength (`quranic:root_000782:B004/m01`); completion without deficiency (`quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`); repeated preservation (`quranic:root_001055:B001/m01`); secured liability (`quranic:root_001055:B006/m01`); demand for an account (`quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Guardianship is a time-bound custody. Proximity to the property is permitted only in its beneficial mode, maturity closes the custodial interval, and fulfillment discharges a liability that has been repeatedly preserved. The orphan's vulnerability limits the guardian rather than enlarging the guardian's ownership.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Approach to a vulnerable body or possession is governed by a threshold, a custodian, and a limit on the custodian's own power.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:31-34 protect children, sexual integrity, life, and orphan property through prohibitions on killing, approaching, excess retaliation, and premature control.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Poverty appears as a hand stripped bare, sexual wrong as crossing a measured approach-zone, retaliation as delegated force under a stop, and covenant as repeated inspection of entrusted property.

parent_channels.name: P2 (17:23-39): Conduct Tested Against Measure

subchannels.name: Market Completion and Balanced Weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: A transaction is completed without deficit by filling the measure and aligning weight to an upright standard.
subchannels.active_motifs: completion without lack (`quranic:root_001669:B001/m01`); measuring food (`quranic:root_001335:B001/m01`); balance instrument (`quranic:root_001225:B001/m01`); estimating by weight (`quranic:root_001645:B001/m01`); justice as balanced scale (`quranic:root_001645:B002/m01`); upright proportion (`quranic:root_001273:B008/m01`); beneficial good (`quranic:root_000452:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Completion, vessel-measure, weight, and uprightness form one calibrated exchange. The transaction is good because the standard reaches both quantity and alignment, leaving no deficit hidden in the transfer.

subchannels.name: Evidence Must Precede Pursuit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim may be followed only where knowledge supplies a trace, because hearing, sight, and the inward organ will each answer for their participation.
subchannels.active_motifs: following a trace (`quranic:root_001247:B001/m01`); disclosed knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); acoustic perception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); visual perception (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); inwardly burning heart (`quranic:root_001122:B002/m01`); reciprocal questioning (`quranic:root_000661:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Pursuit is an evidentiary operation: one follows a trace. The sensory organs and heart are not passive instruments but accountable participants, so the absence of knowledge removes the track on which a claim could legitimately proceed.

subchannels.name: A Stride Cannot Outscale Its Terrain
subchannels.scene_or_process: Exultant walking projects a body larger than its actual scale, but neither ground nor mountain yields to that projection.
subchannels.active_motifs: walking motion (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); joy beyond measure (`quranic:root_001412:B001/m01`); piercing and breach (`quranic:root_000405:B001/m01`); traversing through ground (`quranic:root_000405:B002/m01`); earth as the lower field (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); reaching a limit (`quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`); solid elevation (`quranic:root_000217:B001/m01`); bodily length (`quranic:root_000959:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Pride is tested as a false geometry. The stride imagines breach below and equivalence with height above, yet the earth remains unpierced and the mountain unreached. Bodily movement is returned to its actual proportion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Action is corrected by a standard that makes excess, unsupported pursuit, and bodily pretension visible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:35-38 place market measure, evidentiary responsibility, and embodied scale under explicit limits.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Commercial balance extends into epistemic tracking and bodily proportion: claim, perception, stride, ground, and mountain all become objects of calibration.

parent_channels.name: P3 (17:40-60): Unshared Sovereignty and Failed Mediation

subchannels.name: False Allocation of Kin and Rank
subchannels.scene_or_process: A claim assigns preferred offspring to humans and a disfavored category to the divine, exposing its own asymmetrical allocation of lineage, gender, and rule.
subchannels.active_motifs: selecting a preferred portion (`quranic:root_000873:B002/m01`); lineage and attributed descent (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); female category (`quranic:root_000058:B001/m01`); possession and rule (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); unsupported utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B005/m01`); magnitude and gravity (`quranic:root_001029:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The statement is internally exposed by its distribution. Selection, lineage, gender, and sovereignty are arranged so that the speakers reserve what they rank higher and project the other share upward. The enormity lies in treating sovereignty as divisible family property.

subchannels.name: Imagined Rivals Become Throne-Seekers
subchannels.scene_or_process: If rival deities existed, they would still have to seek a route toward the raised seat on which rule is stabilized.
subchannels.active_motifs: worshiped object (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); seeking a route (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); extended way (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); elevated royal seat (`quranic:root_001000:B001/m01`); supporting structure of rule (`quranic:root_001000:B006/m01`); transcendence from the attribution (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The hypothetical rivals do not occupy parallel thrones. They become route-seekers toward the one raised structure that gives rule its support. The scenario therefore collapses plurality into dependence before the explicit transcendence formula closes it.

subchannels.name: The Cosmos Swims in Praise Beyond Comprehension
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sky, earth, and every thing move in a field of praise whose motion is real even where human understanding cannot parse it.
subchannels.active_motifs: worshipful praise (`quranic:root_000666:B001/m01`); swimming or coursing (`quranic:root_000666:B004/m01`); sky as what rises and covers (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); earth below sky (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); sevenfold number (`quranic:root_000669:B001/m01`); object of predication (`quranic:root_000831:B001/m01`); praise (`quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`); comprehension (`quranic:root_001171:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Praise is not reduced to human-format speech. The swimming sense gives it distributed motion through the created field, while the failure of comprehension belongs to the listener rather than to the praising bodies. Universal dependence is thus kinetic and acoustic at once.

subchannels.name: Invoked Powers Cannot Lift or Reroute Harm
subchannels.scene_or_process: Alleged powers neither possess the operation needed to uncover harm nor redirect it; they are themselves petitioners seeking a nearer means.
subchannels.active_motifs: summoning by speech (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); uncertain claim (`quranic:root_000633:B001/m01`); possession and disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); lifting a cover (`quranic:root_001302:B001/m01`); injury and deficiency (`quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`); transformation from one state (`quranic:root_000373:B001/m01`); approach by a means (`quranic:root_001649:B001/m01`); nearness (`quranic:root_001212:B001/m01`); hopeful expectation (`quranic:root_000548:B001/m01`); alert fear (`quranic:root_000447:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The alleged intermediary fails at both removal and conversion: it cannot uncover the injury or move it elsewhere. The same beings then appear as seekers of approach, hope, and fear. Mediation remains possible only as dependent petition, not autonomous control.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Every proposed division or intermediary remains inside a sovereignty it cannot partition, approach as a rival, or operate independently.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:40-44 reject attributed offspring and rival gods, while 17:54-57 deny delegated control and show invoked beings themselves seeking nearness.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Rival deities become petitioners toward the throne, cosmic praise becomes swimming motion, and alleged intermediaries are recast as dependent operators unable to lift or reroute harm.

parent_channels.name: P3 (17:40-60): Revelation Through Blocked Faculties

subchannels.name: Varied Recitation Produces Deflection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Discourse is turned through multiple forms to trigger recollection, yet the same rotation is answered by increased recoil.
subchannels.active_motifs: turning through forms (`quranic:root_000860:B002/m01`); gathered recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); recovered remembrance (`quranic:root_000516:B003/m01`); reminder-object (`quranic:root_000516:B009/m01`); increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); recoil and distance (`quranic:root_001532:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Variation is intended to rotate the text toward memory, but the receiver converts that movement into recoil. The same dynamic verb-field therefore holds communicative adaptability and audience deflection in tension.

subchannels.name: Screen, Sheath, and Ear-Weight
subchannels.scene_or_process: Access is blocked at successive layers: an interpersonal screen prevents arrival, protective sheaths close around the inner organ, and mass in the ear prevents reception.
subchannels.active_motifs: barred access (`quranic:root_000294:B001/m01`); screening cover (`quranic:root_000294:B002/m01`); covering between persons (`quranic:root_000674:B005/m01`); heart as inner core (`quranic:root_001248:B001/m01`); protective sheath (`quranic:root_001324:B001/m01`); ear as receiving organ (`quranic:root_000022:B001/m01`); heavy auditory load (`quranic:root_001674:B001/m01`); comprehension (`quranic:root_001171:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The obstruction is anatomically layered. A screen interrupts relation outside the body; sheaths protect the heart from penetration; weight disables the ear's receptivity. The text is present, but each stage of access has acquired its own barrier.

subchannels.name: Covert Listening Becomes a Counterfeit Frame
subchannels.scene_or_process: Listeners gather sound in secret, recode the speaker as bewitched, strike analogies around him, and thereby lose the route they claim to assess.
subchannels.active_motifs: acoustic perception (`quranic:root_000741:B001/m01`); secret consultation (`quranic:root_001476:B005/m01`); withholding the right (`quranic:root_000967:B008/m01`); following behind (`quranic:root_000175:B001/m01`); human male (`quranic:root_000546:B002/m01`); magical diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); displaying an analogy (`quranic:root_000906:B003/m01`); represented comparison (`quranic:root_001397:B003/m01`); losing the intended course (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); extended road (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Hearing occurs, but interpretation is captured by a covert social frame. The label `مسحورا` and the struck comparisons substitute an image of the messenger for engagement with the message. Their analogical activity does not find a route; it manufactures the condition of route-loss.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A communicated text reaches listeners through channels that can be redirected, screened, weighted, or converted into hostile paraphrase.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:41 and 17:45-48 describe varied recitation, aversion, a hidden screen, heart-coverings, ear-weight, turning away, covert listening, accusation, and loss of a path.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Rejection becomes a layered sensory apparatus: a barrier before the speaker, sheaths around the interior, mass in the ear, rotation of the back, and a counterfeit interpretive frame.

parent_channels.name: P3 (17:40-60): Resistant Matter Reconstituted by a Summons

subchannels.name: Bone, Fragment, Stone, and Iron Remade
subchannels.scene_or_process: Dispersed organic remains and resistant mineral bodies are all returned to a newly measured form by the originator.
subchannels.active_motifs: hard bone (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); pulverized remains (`quranic:root_000578:B001/m01`); solid stone (`quranic:root_000296:B003/m01`); resistant iron (`quranic:root_000002:B004/m01`); measuring a form (`quranic:root_000434:B001/m01`); originating existence (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); opening and splitting (`quranic:root_001165:B001/m01`); origination and beginning (`quranic:root_001165:B002/m01`); newness after cutting (`quranic:root_000227:B004/m01`); return after departure (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); skeptical head-motion (`quranic:root_001526:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The objection moves from decay to maximal resistance, but both are placed inside the same productive operation. Creation is measurement and origination; newness itself carries the trace of a prior cut. The head's skeptical oscillation becomes a small bodily rehearsal of the return it denies.

subchannels.name: Call, Piercing Answer, and Contracted Duration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A call reaches the dispersed subjects, their answer breaks through, and the interval they considered long contracts in retrospect.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); piercing cut (`quranic:root_000273:B001/m01`); answer to speech (`quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`); praise (`quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`); uncertain estimation (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); remaining in place (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`); small quantity (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); bounded day (`quranic:root_001700:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Resurrection is also a communication event. The summons supplies direction, response opens a passage through separation, and praise accompanies the transition. Once the answering subjects stand within the new event, their former duration is recalibrated as little.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material disintegration and apparent hardness do not prevent a new formation when the originating power calls the dispersed subject back.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:49-52 move from bones and fragments through stone, iron, first creation, skeptical head-motion, divine call, response, and the contraction of elapsed time.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Resurrection is modeled as fresh measurement after cutting, while response functions like a piercing answer through apparently closed material.

parent_channels.name: P3 (17:40-60): Signs That Expose Disposition

subchannels.name: Inscribed End and the Rejected Visible Sign
subchannels.scene_or_process: A settlement's end is already written; earlier denial blocks repetition of signs, while a conspicuous living sign is wronged and becomes warning rather than compulsion.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered settlement (`quranic:root_001222:B001/m01`); extinction (`quranic:root_001596:B001/m01`); preceding time (`quranic:root_001198:B002/m01`); written line (`quranic:root_000704:B001/m01`); barrier against access (`quranic:root_001448:B002/m01`); dispatch of a sign (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); manifest token (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); denial of truth (`quranic:root_001290:B001/m01`); she-camel (`quranic:root_001567:B002/m01`); visual disclosure (`quranic:root_000121:B001/m01`); induced warning-fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Inscription fixes the town's temporal horizon, while the history of denial governs whether another sign will be sent. The she-camel is a visible, embodied token, yet visibility does not force fidelity. The sign instead discloses how its recipients handle entrusted evidence.

subchannels.name: Encompassing Vision as Assay and Amplifier
subchannels.scene_or_process: An encompassing field contains the audience while a shown vision and an entangled tree test it; warning then increases either caution or overflowing resistance.
subchannels.active_motifs: sensory and cognitive enclosure (`quranic:root_000372:B001/m01`); complete encompassing knowledge (`quranic:root_000372:B004/m01`); dream-vision (`quranic:root_000531:B003/m01`); showing and disclosure (`quranic:root_000531:B012/m01`); assay of metal and person (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); rooted tree (`quranic:root_000777:B001/m01`); entangled contention (`quranic:root_000777:B002/m01`); expulsion under curse (`quranic:root_001359:B001/m01`); induced fear (`quranic:root_000447:B002/m01`); increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); overflow beyond limit (`quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The audience is already inside an encompassing field, so the vision is not needed to overcome divine distance. It functions as an assay. The tree's entanglement materializes contested interpretation, and warning becomes an amplifier that reveals whether the tested material tempers or overflows.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A sign does not compel a neutral observer; it enters a preexisting disposition and makes acceptance, denial, fear, or overflow visible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:58-60 join inscribed destruction, withheld signs after earlier denial, the visible she-camel, warning, an encompassing vision, a cursed tree, and increased transgression.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Warning is less a coercive spectacle than an assay: inscription fixes the outcome, visible evidence tests the receiver, and the receiver's reaction can amplify the very excess being warned against.

parent_channels.name: P4 (17:61-77): Adversarial Recruitment Under Bounded Authority

subchannels.name: Clay Refusal Becomes a Bridle Claim
subchannels.scene_or_process: A creature refuses the commanded lowering before a clay-made human, then claims that delayed time will let him seize the descendant line from the chin and lead it.
subchannels.active_motifs: prostrating descent (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); originating creation (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); clay material (`quranic:root_000963:B001/m01`); clay as formed disposition (`quranic:root_000963:B004/m01`); conferred honor (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); temporal delay (`quranic:root_000019:B002/m01`); chin and palate (`quranic:root_000363:B001/m01`); bridling under the chin (`quranic:root_000363:B003/m01`); minute scattered particles (`quranic:root_000511:B001/m01`); small remainder (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The refusal to lower oneself becomes a project of lowering others. Clay names the created material, while `لأحتنكن` supplies the concrete mechanics of bridling a line at the chin. The latent particle-field in `ذرية` disperses that line into a multitude; delay opens the bounded interval in which the claim can be tested.

subchannels.name: Voice, Cavalry, Foot, and Co-Ownership
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recruitment agitates susceptible persons by sound, surrounds them with mounted and foot forces, enters their holdings and offspring, and keeps them moving by promise.
subchannels.active_motifs: destabilizing provocation (`quranic:root_001151:B001/m01`); sounded voice (`quranic:root_000890:B001/m01`); driving an imported force (`quranic:root_000252:B001/m01`); gathering by clamor (`quranic:root_000252:B002/m01`); horses as mounted force (`quranic:root_000454:B002/m01`); foot movement (`quranic:root_000546:B003/m01`); participation in a share (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); promise that opens expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); pre-assault stallion roar (`quranic:root_001662:B005/m01`); deceptive embellishment (`quranic:root_001078:B008/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The verbs form an escalating mobilization. Sound first unsettles, clamor gathers a force, mounted and foot units close distance, and participation enters the social body through holdings and offspring. Promise supplies forward pull, while its separate latent roar anticipates assault; deceptive display leaves that expectation without a stable object.

subchannels.name: Jurisdiction Stops at Protected Servants
subchannels.scene_or_process: Adversarial authority reaches those who follow it but cannot establish a binding claim over servants held within another custody.
subchannels.active_motifs: obedient servant (`quranic:root_000973:B003/m01`); delegated authority (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); competent custodian (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); sufficiency in undertaking (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The boundary is relational, not geographic. Following activates the adversary's constituency, whereas servanthood places the person under a sufficient custodian. Authority is therefore tested by allegiance and remains unable to become an independent jurisdiction.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A refusal to recognize bestowed rank becomes a campaign of recruitment, but the campaign operates only through permitted instruments and stops at protected allegiance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:61-65 move from the refusal to prostrate through a claim over Adam's offspring, mobilized voice and forces, shared wealth and children, false promise, and the exclusion of faithful servants from adversarial authority.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The adversary's threat becomes a bridle fitted at the chin, recruitment becomes a combined cavalry-and-infantry operation, and divine custody appears as a jurisdictional boundary rather than the absence of pressure.

parent_channels.name: P4 (17:61-77): Conveyance Across Unstable Elements

subchannels.name: A Vessel Gently Propelled Through the Sea
subchannels.scene_or_process: A curved carrier is moved without violent impact through a broad water-field so that travelers can seek a bestowed surplus.
subchannels.active_motifs: gentle propulsion (`quranic:root_000625:B001/m01`); curved ship-form (`quranic:root_001177:B003/m01`); broad sea (`quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`); seafaring passage (`quranic:root_000086:B009/m01`); seeking an object (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); bestowed bounty (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`); mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The ship does not explain its own motion. Its rounded structure receives a gentle drive across an element larger than itself, while the sought bounty lies beyond the passengers' present possession. Conveyance is thus a coordinated relation among carrier, current, direction, and mercy.

subchannels.name: Crisis Call, Separating Rescue, and Amnesia
subchannels.scene_or_process: Harm closes around travelers, every invoked support disappears except one, rescue separates them from the sea onto firm land, and restored security permits withdrawal.
subchannels.active_motifs: affecting contact (`quranic:root_001423:B004/m01`); injury and deficiency (`quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`); disappearance of a sought object (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); rescue by separating out (`quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`); dry land (`quranic:root_000104:B005/m01`); turning the side away (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`); covering a received favor (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Crisis strips the field of imagined supports. Rescue is a physical differentiation from danger, but arrival on land also restores the option to turn one's side away. The sequence exposes amnesia as a change in posture produced by changed footing.

subchannels.name: Land Sink, Stone Storm, Returning Sea
subchannels.scene_or_process: Apparent security can invert: land can swallow from below, a stone-bearing wind can strike from above, or a return to sea can end in a breaking gale and engulfment.
subchannels.active_motifs: sinking into earth (`quranic:root_000410:B001/m01`); exposed side (`quranic:root_000262:B001/m01`); stone-bearing wind (`quranic:root_000325:B003/m01`); return after departure (`quranic:root_001058:B001/m01`); dispatch (`quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`); rapid breaking (`quranic:root_001233:B001/m01`); crashing sound (`quranic:root_001233:B005/m01`); wind (`quranic:root_000609:B003/m01`); engulfing drowning (`quranic:root_001080:B001/m01`); pursuing claimant (`quranic:root_000175:B005/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: No element is inherently a refuge. Ground, sky, and sea each acquire a mode of reversal, and the return voyage can be broken by an atmosphere that turns into a crushing instrument. Safety cannot be inferred from the medium currently underfoot.

subchannels.name: Honored Carriage Across Land and Sea
subchannels.scene_or_process: Human descendants are dignified by being borne through both domains, supplied with wholesome sustenance, and ranked among created things.
subchannels.active_motifs: conferred honor (`quranic:root_001294:B001/m01`); descendants (`quranic:root_000156:B007/m01`); bearing a load (`quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`); conveyance device (`quranic:root_000357:B006/m01`); dry land (`quranic:root_000104:B005/m01`); broad sea (`quranic:root_000086:B001/m01`); apportioned provision (`quranic:root_000560:B001/m01`); wholesome provision (`quranic:root_000961:B001/m01`); rank and merit (`quranic:root_001163:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Carriage is itself part of the honor: bodies that cannot master land and sea are nevertheless equipped to cross both. Provision sustains the carried body, and rank names a bestowed differentiation rather than self-generated immunity.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Safe passage depends on a carrier and a directing mercy that neither traveler nor vehicle possesses autonomously.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:66-70 move from ships driven at sea through crisis invocation and rescue to land and sea threats, then close by honoring and carrying Adam's children with provision.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Navigation is a gentle propulsion, rescue is a separating extraction onto dry ground, and safety remains reversible across land, stone-bearing wind, returning sea, and engulfing gale.

parent_channels.name: P4 (17:61-77): Judgment Text and Oriented Sight

subchannels.name: Communities Called to Read Their Book
subchannels.scene_or_process: Each gathered people is summoned by its orienting exemplar, receives a written object in the right hand, reads it, and is protected from even filament-sized misplacement.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered community (`quranic:root_000053:B004/m01`); orienting exemplar (`quranic:root_000053:B009/m01`); vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); joined written object (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); right hand (`quranic:root_001698:B002/m01`); right as capacity (`quranic:root_001698:B004/m01`); reading aloud (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); fine filament (`quranic:root_001127:B002/m01`); material action misplaced in time or location (`quranic:root_000967:B004/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Judgment joins collective orientation to individual legibility. The exemplar identifies the route a people followed, but each recipient must still hold and voice the written account. The filament image makes justice exact at a scale beneath ordinary social notice.

subchannels.name: Blindness Extends Into Path-Loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: Failure of sight in the present field carries into the later field, where the absent orientation becomes still greater deviation from the road.
subchannels.active_motifs: loss of sight (`quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`); inward blindness (`quranic:root_001049:B002/m01`); later field (`quranic:root_000019:B001/m01`); deviation from a course (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); extended path (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Blindness is both faculty-loss and failed orientation. The later condition does not arbitrarily replace the present one; it extends it until deviation from the path becomes explicit. Judgment discloses the route already being traveled.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Judgment makes affiliation and action legible, while the orientation with which a person meets the record determines whether the path remains visible.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:71-72 call each community with its leader or record, distinguish receiving and reading by the right hand, deny the least injustice, and carry present blindness into greater path-loss.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Communal affiliation becomes a summoned exemplar, the book is a joined material object received by the hand of capacity, and even a threadlike remainder is protected from misallocation.

parent_channels.name: P4 (17:61-77): Stabilization Under Substitution and Displacement

subchannels.name: Enticed Fabrication and Purchased Friendship
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pressure diverts the receiver from what was imparted so that another text might be fabricated and rewarded with protective intimacy.
subchannels.active_motifs: enticement away from the right (`quranic:root_001128:B003/m01`); hidden communication (`quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`); fabricated lie (`quranic:root_001150:B003/m01`); substitution and change (`quranic:root_001119:B003/m01`); otherness (`quranic:root_001119:B005/m01`); adopting a relation (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); affection through an opening (`quranic:root_000435:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The proposed exchange has two coordinated movements: received speech is displaced by an invented other, and public resistance is displaced by intimate acceptance. The friendship is therefore not incidental reward but the social price attached to textual substitution.

subchannels.name: Stabilization Against a Small Lean
subchannels.scene_or_process: External pressure nearly inclines the body, but reinforcement fixes it before even a slight lean becomes alignment.
subchannels.active_motifs: stability after movement (`quranic:root_000192:B001/m01`); reinforcing attachment (`quranic:root_000192:B003/m01`); near action (`quranic:root_001329:B002/m01`); strong side and support (`quranic:root_000596:B001/m01`); bodily leaning (`quranic:root_000596:B002/m01`); small quantity (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Fidelity is rendered as posture. Nearness measures the pressure's real force, while stabilization supplies a counterforce before inclination settles into dependence on another side. A small lean matters because direction begins before full displacement.

subchannels.name: Doubled Tasting Across Life and Death
subchannels.scene_or_process: Had the lean occurred, its consequence would have been experienced in multiplied form across both modes of existence, without an assisting force.
subchannels.active_motifs: experiential tasting (`quranic:root_000526:B002/m01`); doubling (`quranic:root_000909:B002/m01`); living creature (`quranic:root_000383:B003/m01`); loss of life (`quranic:root_001454:B001/m01`); assisting vindication (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Consequence is not merely announced; it is ingested as taste. Doubling across life and death closes off any domain in which the compromise could remain harmless, while the absent helper denies an external offset to that experience.

subchannels.name: Expulsion Activates an Invariant Reversal
subchannels.scene_or_process: Opponents try to unsettle the messenger from the land, but successful removal would shorten their own stay under an established historical pattern.
subchannels.active_motifs: destabilizing displacement (`quranic:root_001151:B001/m01`); going out (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); remaining in place (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`); position after another (`quranic:root_000433:B002/m01`); small duration (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`); recurrent practice (`quranic:root_000750:B001/m01`); transformation from a state (`quranic:root_000373:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The attempted removal contains its own reversal. If the messenger is made to leave, the removers lose the condition that sustains their own residence. The prior messenger-pattern converts territorial power into a temporary position rather than a stable exception.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Pressure seeks to move the messenger away from received speech and inhabited ground, while stabilization holds both utterance and station against substitution.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:73-77 describe enticement to fabricate other revelation, divine stabilization, the danger of leaning, doubled life and death, attempted expulsion, and an invariant messenger-pattern.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Doctrinal compromise becomes bodily lean, punishment becomes doubled tasting across life and death, and territorial removal activates a historical rule that makes the removers' own stay brief.

parent_channels.name: P5 (17:78-96): Worship Across the Light Cycle

subchannels.name: Decline, Darkness, and Witnessed Dawn
subchannels.scene_or_process: Prayer is maintained as the sun tilts from its station, darkness gathers, and dawn breaks into a recitation attended by witnesses.
subchannels.active_motifs: maintaining an obligation (`quranic:root_001273:B004/m01`); prayer and invocation (`quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`); sun (`quranic:root_000818:B001/m01`); decline from a midpoint (`quranic:root_000483:B002/m01`); night darkness (`quranic:root_001086:B001/m01`); dawn breaking open (`quranic:root_001132:B002/m01`); gathered recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); witnessed presence (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The schedule is generated by visible transformations. Decline begins the arc, darkness thickens it, and dawn ruptures it; maintained prayer fixes human attention at those changes. Recitation at dawn is not solitary enclosure but an event marked by presence.

subchannels.name: Night Waking Toward a Raised Station
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sleep is interrupted for an added act of worship whose gift-character opens toward being raised into a praised standing place.
subchannels.active_motifs: night (`quranic:root_001392:B001/m01`); sleep and stillness (`quranic:root_001577:B001/m01`); extra gift (`quranic:root_001538:B001/m01`); rousing a sleeper from stillness (`quranic:root_000129:B001/m01`); standing station (`quranic:root_001273:B006/m01`); praise (`quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The night act reverses bodily stillness by voluntary waking. Because it is an addition rather than a debt, it has the form of a gift; the corresponding horizon is another raising, this time into a station defined by praise.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Worship is stationed at transitions in light and wakefulness so that recurring cosmic change becomes a disciplined rhythm of address.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:78-79 order prayer from the sun's decline through night darkness, single out dawn recitation as witnessed, and add a night vigil oriented toward a praised station.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The liturgical schedule is a sequence of thresholds rather than clock units, dawn recitation gathers and voices a text in the opening light, and voluntary waking becomes dispatch toward a raised station.

parent_channels.name: P5 (17:78-96): Truthful Passage, Displacement, and Repair

subchannels.name: True Ingress, True Egress, Supporting Authority
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person crosses in and out through thresholds whose alignment is secured by truth and whose vulnerable transition receives a nearby supporting power.
subchannels.active_motifs: entry (`quranic:root_000464:B001/m01`); exit (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); stable truth (`quranic:root_000852:B002/m01`); truthfulness (`quranic:root_000852:B003/m01`); delegated authority (`quranic:root_000732:B003/m01`); assisting support (`quranic:root_001510:B001/m01`); boundary of nearness (`quranic:root_004482:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Entry and exit are distinct operations and each must be fitted to truth. Supporting authority stands at the exposed transition, not as a substitute for passage but as the force that keeps it from being captured by surrounding pressure.

subchannels.name: Truth Arrives and Falsehood Loses Its Trace
subchannels.scene_or_process: Truth reaches the scene, fixes what is real, and thereby removes the unstable rival until its trace disappears.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrival (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`); truth and reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); establishing what is due (`quranic:root_000347:B005/m01`); instability of falsehood (`quranic:root_000127:B001/m01`); removal of falsehood (`quranic:root_000127:B002/m01`); vanishing trace (`quranic:root_000651:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The opposition is not between equally stable substances. Truth's arrival establishes, whereas falsehood is internally disposed to disappear. Displacement occurs because the rival cannot retain a trace in the field truth makes actual.

subchannels.name: Descending Recitation Heals at an Exposed Brink
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recitation is delivered into the human field as healing and merciful cover at an exposed brink, but resistant reception converts the same arrival into accumulating loss.
subchannels.active_motifs: staged descent (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); gathered recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); healing (`quranic:root_000806:B001/m01`); exposed edge or brink (`quranic:root_000806:B002/m01`); mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); settled trust (`quranic:root_000054:B002/m01`); increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); suffered loss (`quranic:root_000409:B001/m01`); commercial depletion (`quranic:root_000409:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Healing removes an affliction, while the separate brink sense places the recipient at an exposed edge where the intervention matters. Mercy names the sheltering relation in which recovery can take hold. When reception remains unjust, accumulation still occurs, but what accumulates is depletion.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Sound passage requires true entry, true exit, and sustaining authority, while revelation enters a damaged field as a force that displaces falsehood and restores receptive bodies.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:80-82 pray for truthful ingress and egress, announce truth's arrival and falsehood's vanishing, and describe the Qur'an's descent as healing and mercy that can increase the resistant only in loss.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral truth becomes the structural fit of a threshold crossing, falsehood loses its trace on contact, and healing reaches a subject poised at an exposed brink.
