parent_channels.name: P5 (17:78-96): Disposition Shapes the Route

subchannels.name: Favor Produces a Turn; Harm Produces Despair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Received benefit prompts sideward withdrawal, whereas injurious contact collapses expectation; opposite circumstances expose a common instability of orientation.
subchannels.active_motifs: conferred benefit (`quranic:root_001525:B001/m01`); human social being (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); turning the side away (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`); remoteness by one's flank (`quranic:root_001463:B002/m01`); bodily side (`quranic:root_000262:B001/m01`); affecting contact (`quranic:root_001423:B004/m01`); injurious evil (`quranic:root_000787:B001/m01`); severed hope (`quranic:root_001690:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The two reactions point in different emotional directions but share a failure to remain rightly related. Benefit turns the body away from its source; harm cuts the future off from expectation. Circumstance reveals posture rather than creating it from nothing.

subchannels.name: Each Action Runs in Its Formed Channel
subchannels.scene_or_process: Work issues through a person's shaping, binding, or accustomed route, while guidance is assessed by the path that configuration actually produces.
subchannels.active_motifs: work and acquisition (`quranic:root_001046:B001/m01`); formed route (`quranic:root_000813:B002/m01`); binding fetter or shape (`quranic:root_000813:B003/m01`); disclosed knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); route-guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); guided arrival (`quranic:root_001583:B002/m01`); extended path (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `شاكلة` locates action in a preformed channel: a configuration both shapes and constrains what flows from it. Guidance is therefore visible not in self-description but in the road the configured action lays down.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: External conditions disclose an internal configuration that determines posture, direction, and the kind of path an action makes.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:83-84 contrast withdrawal under favor and despair under harm, then state that each acts according to `شاكلته` while God best knows the better-guided path.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Favor and injury rotate the body in opposite directions, while `شاكلة` makes conduct the release of a formed channel or tether rather than an isolated choice.

parent_channels.name: P5 (17:78-96): Bounded Knowledge and Revocable Revelation

subchannels.name: The Spirit at the Boundary of Inquiry
subchannels.scene_or_process: Questioning reaches toward the life-principle but is stopped at its relation to command, leaving the questioners with a deliberately small share of knowledge.
subchannels.active_motifs: requesting an account (`quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`); life-breath and spirit (`quranic:root_000609:B001/m01`); matter or affair (`quranic:root_000051:B001/m01`); disclosed knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); small quantity (`quranic:root_001251:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The response does not deny the object; it relocates it within a domain whose operation is not exhausted by human analysis. The small allotment of knowledge marks an epistemic boundary while preserving the spirit's relation to command.

subchannels.name: Revelation Held by Mercy Rather Than Possession
subchannels.scene_or_process: The imparted text could be carried away from its recipient, leaving no custodian able to recover it, but mercy maintains it as an exceptional bounty.
subchannels.active_motifs: willing determination (`quranic:root_000831:B002/m01`); hidden communication (`quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`); carrying something away (`quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`); finding after loss (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`); competent custodian (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); bestowed bounty (`quranic:root_001163:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Revelation is not secured by the receiver's control over it. The removal scenario exposes dependence at the level of memory and text, and the absence of an alternate custodian makes continued possession legible as mercy.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human access to life-giving knowledge remains partial, while revealed knowledge remains a retained gift rather than an independently possessed archive.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:85-87 answer the question about the spirit with divine command and little human knowledge, then state that revelation could be removed except for preserving mercy and bounty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The spirit is placed at the boundary between command and disclosure, while revelation's hypothetical removal turns memory into a custody arrangement requiring a protecting agent.

parent_channels.name: P5 (17:78-96): Inimitability Against Collective Backing

subchannels.name: Humans and Jinn Assemble With Rear Support
subchannels.scene_or_process: Visible and hidden beings gather, attempt to bring forth a counterpart, and reinforce one another from behind, yet no likeness reaches the disclosed object.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathering into one body (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`); human being (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); hidden jinn (`quranic:root_000266:B005/m01`); bringing forth (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); likeness (`quranic:root_001397:B001/m01`); represented counterpart (`quranic:root_001397:B008/m01`); rear support (`quranic:root_000970:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The challenge grants maximal coalition: different orders of creature, unified effort, and mutual backing. What fails is not coordination but equivalence. Support can amplify a productive body without changing the kind of object it can produce.

subchannels.name: Rotated Examples Meet Repeated Closure
subchannels.scene_or_process: Discourse turns a complete range of examples toward the audience, but repeated presentation is answered by refusal and the covering of received benefit.
subchannels.active_motifs: variation by rotation (`quranic:root_000860:B002/m01`); gathered recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); totality (`quranic:root_001315:B003/m01`); illustrative example (`quranic:root_001397:B003/m01`); example as admonitory sign (`quranic:root_001397:B011/m01`); refusal (`quranic:root_000008:B001/m01`); covering truth (`quranic:root_001307:B003/m01`); covering a favor (`quranic:root_001307:B004/m01`); numerical abundance (`quranic:root_001286:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The examples are not a packed substitute for argument; each rotation offers another angle of access. Refusal persists across the range, so abundance measures the audience's closure as much as the discourse's adaptability.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Increasing the number and diversity of producers does not overcome a difference in kind between revealed discourse and attempted likeness.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:88-89 challenge humans and jinn to gather with mutual support to produce the Qur'an's likeness, then note the many varied examples met by persistent refusal and covering.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Collaboration becomes a supporting rear-line rather than creative equivalence, and rhetorical variation functions as repeated rotation around an audience that keeps closing itself.

parent_channels.name: P5 (17:78-96): Engineered Proof Demanded From an Embodied Messenger

subchannels.name: A Ruptured Spring and Irrigated Garden
subchannels.scene_or_process: The earth is forced open into a spring, then enclosed cultivation is fitted with palms, vines, and channels cut through its interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: rupturing an inflow (`quranic:root_001132:B001/m01`); sudden massed surge (`quranic:root_001132:B003/m01`); earth (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); water spring (`quranic:root_001469:B001/m01`); enclosed garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); date palm (`quranic:root_001483:B001/m01`); grapevine (`quranic:root_001050:B001/m01`); river channel (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); cutting a gap (`quranic:root_000435:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The demand specifies an engineered scene: rupture, spring, planted enclosure, and channels cut between growth. The separate sudden-surge sense intensifies the demanded breakthrough. The skeptics seek a flow and layout immediately inspectable and answerable to their design.

subchannels.name: Falling Sky and a Facing Entourage
subchannels.scene_or_process: Proof is escalated from cultivated ground to pieces of sky made to fall, followed by deity and angels brought face-to-face.
subchannels.active_motifs: falling from above (`quranic:root_000719:B001/m01`); raised sky (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); uncertain claim (`quranic:root_000633:B001/m01`); broken fragment (`quranic:root_001298:B004/m01`); bringing into presence (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`); worshiped deity (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); ruling sovereignty (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); direct facing (`quranic:root_001198:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The prescribed sign now destroys the stable canopy and replaces mediated speech with compulsory confrontation. Fragmentation and facing show that the demand is not simply for evidence; it asks to govern the mode by which transcendence must become present.

subchannels.name: Gilded House, Ascent, and Handheld Book
subchannels.scene_or_process: Architectural wealth supplies a launch point, ascent penetrates the sky, and a descended written object is made available for direct reading.
subchannels.active_motifs: dwelling (`quranic:root_000166:B001/m01`); ornament (`quranic:root_000628:B001/m01`); gold (`quranic:root_000628:B002/m01`); ascending motion (`quranic:root_000588:B001/m01`); raised sky (`quranic:root_000745:B004/m01`); delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); joined written object (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); reading aloud (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The demanded route joins status, vertical access, and documentary possession. A gilded dwelling authenticates the traveler below; ascent authenticates access above; a descended book then converts that access into an object the skeptics can hold and read on their own terms.

subchannels.name: The Medium Must Match the Inhabited Field
subchannels.scene_or_process: The objection treats visible human embodiment as disqualifying, while the answer fits a messenger's embodiment to the kind of beings walking securely in the receiving world.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible human skin (`quranic:root_000120:B002/m01`); dispatched messenger (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); walking motion (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); settled tranquility (`quranic:root_003669:B001/m01`); delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); earth (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); witnessed presence (`quranic:root_000822:B001/m01`); sufficiency in undertaking (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Embodiment is recast from defect to communicative fit. A community of earthly walkers receives a messenger who can occupy its perceptual and practical field; a different stable population would require a different descending medium. Witness, not spectacle on demand, secures the relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Skeptical demands prescribe material transformations and privileged access, then reject the ordinary embodied medium through which guidance has actually arrived.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:90-96 demand springs, gardens, rivers, falling sky, divine and angelic appearance, a gold house, ascent, and a readable book, before objecting to a human messenger and receiving an answer based on the inhabitants' own mode.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The requested proof sequence moves from hydraulic engineering to cosmic demolition and architectural elevation, revealing a desire to control not only the sign but its production protocol.

parent_channels.name: P6 (17:97-111): Embodied Inversion and Rekindled Consequence

subchannels.name: Face-Down Gathering With Closed Faculties
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those who refuse guidance are driven together on their faces, with the receiving faculties of sight, speech, and hearing closed and no shelter beyond the destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: route-guidance (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); deviation from a course (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); gathering by driving (`quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`); face as oriented surface (`quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`); blindness (`quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`); muteness (`quranic:root_000145:B001/m01`); deafness (`quranic:root_000884:B001/m01`); refuge (`quranic:root_000070:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The gathering turns failed reception into bodily arrangement. A face that did not orient to guidance becomes the surface dragged against the route, while sight, speech, and hearing no longer mediate escape. The destination gathers the consequences into one embodied scene.

subchannels.name: A Fading Fire Reignited
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fire loses visible intensity, then is kindled again so that diminution becomes the occasion for renewed burning.
subchannels.active_motifs: fire's subsiding trace (`quranic:root_000391:B001/m01`); ignition (`quranic:root_000708:B001/m01`); increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); fire-pit (`quranic:root_000708:B009/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: `خبت` and `سعيرا` create a pulse rather than a static blaze. The first marks fire falling low; the second restores active ignition. Increase therefore operates as repeated rekindling, preventing apparent exhaustion from becoming release.

subchannels.name: Resistant Matter Remade Under a Fixed Term
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bone and pulverized remains are dispatched into another formation by the same capacity that formed the greater cosmos, with the event fixed to an undisputed term.
subchannels.active_motifs: hard bone (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); pulverized fragments (`quranic:root_000578:B001/m01`); dispatch of the raised body (`quranic:root_000129:B002/m01`); originating creation (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); operative capacity (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`); fixed term (`quranic:root_000016:B001/m01`); destabilizing doubt (`quranic:root_000616:B001/m01`); refusal (`quranic:root_000008:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The objection again names disintegrated matter, but the answer scales capacity from the larger created field back to the body. The term adds temporal form to material re-formation: neither decay nor uncertainty leaves the event unbounded.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Rejection reappears as an inverted bodily condition, while exhausted matter and exhausted fire remain subject to renewed formation and intensity.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:97-99 describe face-down gathering in blindness, muteness, and deafness, a fading fire repeatedly increased, and the recreation of bones and fragments by the creator of heavens and earth at a fixed term.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Faculties refused in life become the geometry of resurrection, hell behaves as a fire repeatedly stoked after subsiding, and decayed bodies are measured again under a fixed temporal limit.

parent_channels.name: P6 (17:97-111): Signs and Territorial Reversal

subchannels.name: Nine Disclosures and Competing Diagnoses
subchannels.scene_or_process: A measured set of signs opens perception, yet the ruler interprets their bearer as magically displaced and is answered with a diagnosis of doomed judgment.
subchannels.active_motifs: ninefold number (`quranic:root_000181:B001/m01`); visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`); disclosure that opens sight (`quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`); requesting an account (`quranic:root_000661:B001/m01`); uncertain attribution (`quranic:root_000969:B003/m01`); magical diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`); disclosed knowledge (`quranic:root_001040:B001/m01`); delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); insight-producing evidence (`quranic:root_000121:B002/m01`); destruction and loss (`quranic:root_000193:B002/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The signs are not merely visible objects; they are openings for sight. Pharaoh uses the same encounter to diagnose the messenger as displaced, but Moses returns the diagnosis to the ruler whose knowing refusal makes destruction intelligible.

subchannels.name: Attempted Displacement Reverses Into Drowning and Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: A ruler intends to unsettle a people from the land, but he and his force are engulfed; the displaced people then receive settlement before a final appointment gathers all parties together.
subchannels.active_motifs: intending and seeking (`quranic:root_000610:B001/m01`); destabilizing displacement (`quranic:root_001151:B001/m01`); earth and territory (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); engulfing drowning (`quranic:root_001080:B001/m01`); gathering into one body (`quranic:root_000259:B001/m01`); subsequent position (`quranic:root_000131:B002/m01`); settled dwelling (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); appointed promise (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); arrival (`quranic:root_000281:B001/m01`); wrapped collective (`quranic:root_001365:B003/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Territorial control reverses at the point of attempted removal. The force that would detach a people from land is itself detached from life by water; those targeted then settle, while the later appointment folds dispersed historical parties into a single gathered body.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Signs disclose the interpreter as much as their source, and a ruler's attempt to uproot a messenger reverses into the ruler's removal and the recipients' settlement.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:101-104 recall nine signs, Pharaoh's accusation and Moses's counterdiagnosis, attempted displacement from the land, drowning, Israelite settlement, and a final gathered arrival.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: `بصائر` makes signs instruments of sight, Pharaoh's misreading becomes a diagnosis of mental displacement, and his territorial project ends in a wrapped collective brought back into one field.

parent_channels.name: P6 (17:97-111): Staged Revelation and Embodied Reception

subchannels.name: Truthful Descent Through an Announcing Messenger
subchannels.scene_or_process: The message descends with truth and retains truth in arrival, while the messenger carries only the paired communicative tasks of giving news and warning.
subchannels.active_motifs: truth and reality (`quranic:root_000347:B001/m01`); staged descent (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); dispatched messenger (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); good announcement (`quranic:root_000120:B005/m01`); warning (`quranic:root_001488:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Truth qualifies both sourceward descent and arrival, closing a gap in which corruption might be imagined. The messenger does not own the content's effect; his office is bounded to announcing an opening and warning of consequence.

subchannels.name: Differentiated Delivery Fitted to Waiting
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gathered recitation is separated into articulated portions so that it can be read over people across a waiting interval and delivered in successive descent.
subchannels.active_motifs: gathered recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); differentiating parts (`quranic:root_001148:B001/m01`); scattering into portions (`quranic:root_001148:B002/m01`); human community (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); waiting in stability (`quranic:root_001437:B001/m01`); deliberate pacing (`quranic:root_001437:B002/m01`); delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); single occurrence of descent (`quranic:root_001492:B010/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Unity of text and division of delivery are complementary. Differentiation makes the recitation inhabitable over time, and waiting supplies the stable interval in which each portion can be heard. Successive descent is a mode of reception, not fragmentation of source.

subchannels.name: Recitation Descends Into Chin, Tears, and Humility
subchannels.scene_or_process: Those formed by prior knowledge follow the recitation, fall forward onto their chins, voice transcendence, cry, and are increased in lowliness.
subchannels.active_motifs: one voice following another (`quranic:root_000186:B007/m01`); falling from height (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`); turbulent sound or flowing murmur (`quranic:root_000402:B002/m01`); chin (`quranic:root_000515:B001/m01`); prostrating descent (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); transcendence (`quranic:root_000666:B002/m01`); appointed promise (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); audible crying (`quranic:root_000147:B001/m01`); humility (`quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`); increase (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Reception proceeds through a bodily chain. One voice follows another, vertical posture breaks, and the chin meets the ground; the adjacent turbulent-sound sense of `خر` lets the fall carry an audible current into crying. Increase culminates not in control of the text but in deeper humility before it.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Revelation is delivered truthfully in differentiated stages, and receptive knowledge moves from hearing into posture, tears, and increasing humility.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:105-109 describe truthful descent, the messenger's announcing and warning roles, a Qur'an divided for paced recitation, and knowledgeable hearers falling on their chins in prostration and tears.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Textual differentiation becomes a delivery technology fitted to waiting, while reception travels through the whole body and increases lowliness rather than possession.

parent_channels.name: P6 (17:97-111): Addressing Undivided Sovereignty

subchannels.name: Many Names, One Referent, Calibrated Voice
subchannels.scene_or_process: Invocation can approach through multiple beautiful designations, while prayer finds an audible path between excessive projection and concealment.
subchannels.active_motifs: vocal invocation (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); worshiped deity (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); designation and name (`quranic:root_000745:B005/m01`); moral beauty (`quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`); loud voicing (`quranic:root_000269:B001/m01`); lowered voice (`quranic:root_000425:B001/m01`); prayer (`quranic:root_000879:B003/m01`); seeking (`quranic:root_000138:B001/m01`); interval between extremes (`quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`); extended path (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: Plurality belongs to the names' modes of access, not to the addressed reality. The acoustic instruction repeats that logic at the level of voice: neither exposed loudness nor hidden muting monopolizes prayer; a fitted path runs between them.

subchannels.name: Praise Removes Child, Partner, and Protective Superior
subchannels.scene_or_process: Praise negates descent, co-rule, and rescue from subordination, then answers every imagined reduction by magnifying sovereignty.
subchannels.active_motifs: praise (`quranic:root_000355:B001/m01`); adopting a relation (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); child (`quranic:root_001683:B001/m01`); sharing a portion (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`); partner (`quranic:root_000791:B002/m01`); ruling sovereignty (`quranic:root_001444:B003/m01`); close protector (`quranic:root_001684:B003/m01`); protective loyalty (`quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`); abasement (`quranic:root_000519:B001/m01`); greatness (`quranic:root_001281:B001/m01`); majesty and transcendence (`quranic:root_001281:B006/m01`)
subchannels.synthesis: The three negations close three routes of divided rule: inherited relation, lateral partnership, and dependence on a stronger protector. Magnification is the positive operation that follows, restoring every comparison to the scale of undivided sovereignty.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Many beautiful names and varied vocal intensities address one undivided referent whose sovereignty admits no child, partner, or protective superior.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 17:110-111 permit invocation by `الله` or `الرحمن`, regulate vocal volume in prayer, and close with praise for the one without child, partner in rule, or protector from abasement.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Naming expands without partitioning the named, prayer is calibrated inside an acoustic interval, and final magnification removes the last imagined hierarchy above or beside sovereignty.

parent_channels.name: S1. P1 (17:1-22): Misplaced Trusteeship Collapses Into Immobilization
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Agency is surrendered to a substitute, but the substituted support leaves its adopter seated, blamed, expelled, and unable to rise.
parent_channels.active_motifs: adopting or acquiring (`quranic:root_000018:B010/m01`); surrendering a matter to another (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); competent caretaker (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); worshiped substitute (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); abstention from action (`quranic:root_001244:B002/m01`); incapacity to rise (`quranic:root_001244:B009/m01`); weakness after abandonment (`quranic:root_000398:B003/m01`); blame (`quranic:root_000520:B001/m01`); expulsion (`quranic:root_000460:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: A trustee should carry and preserve a transferred matter. Here the false transfer reverses that function: the adopter loses effective support and ends in seated incapacity. Blame and expulsion make the failed delegation social and spatial as well as theological.

parent_channels.name: S2. P2 (17:23-39): Wisdom as a Restraining End-Stop
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hidden communication is engraved as corrective knowledge, restrains misplacement, and closes by showing the fall produced by attaching worship to another object.
parent_channels.active_motifs: secretly imparted knowledge (`quranic:root_001633:B001/m01`); inscription and engraving (`quranic:root_001633:B003/m01`); restraint for correction (`quranic:root_000348:B001/m01`); right judgment (`quranic:root_000348:B003/m01`); exact construction (`quranic:root_000348:B004/m01`); worshiped object (`quranic:root_000047:B001/m01`); assigning a substitute to a role (`quranic:root_000248:B002/m01`); being cast down (`quranic:root_001372:B005/m01`); blame (`quranic:root_001386:B001/m01`); expulsion (`quranic:root_000460:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Wisdom is not only abstract knowledge. Its branch structure joins hidden delivery, durable inscription, corrective restraint, and exact construction. The closing prohibition is its end-stop: false attachment converts ascent toward rule into a cast-down, expelled condition.

parent_channels.name: S3. P3 (17:40-60): Better Speech Blocks the Adversarial Wedge
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A superior utterance is selected because hostile speech acts like a pointed tool driven into the interval between people.
parent_channels.active_motifs: spoken utterance (`quranic:root_001272:B001/m01`); moral beauty (`quranic:root_000323:B001/m01`); beneficent action (`quranic:root_000323:B002/m01`); corruption of relations (`quranic:root_001490:B001/m01`); verbal stab (`quranic:root_001490:B002/m01`); interval between parties (`quranic:root_000170:B002/m01`); connective relation between parties (`quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`); remote rebel (`quranic:root_000796:B004/m01`); human social being (`quranic:root_000059:B001/m01`); active enemy (`quranic:root_000993:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene is a social mechanics of speech. The adversarial utterance penetrates the interval and damages the connection between parties; the better utterance occupies that same interval with beneficent action. Ethical speech is therefore preventative infrastructure against an inserted wedge.

parent_channels.name: S4. P6 (17:97-111): Mercy Imagined as a Hoard
parent_channels.scene_or_process: If humans controlled the stores of mercy, fear of depletion would cause them to retain the contents and constrict their outflow.
parent_channels.active_motifs: possession and disposal (`quranic:root_001444:B002/m01`); safeguarded reserve (`quranic:root_000406:B001/m01`); storehouse keeper (`quranic:root_000406:B003/m01`); mercy (`quranic:root_000552:B001/m01`); holding back (`quranic:root_001424:B001/m01`); restrained retention (`quranic:root_001424:B002/m01`); fearful anticipation (`quranic:root_000413:B001/m01`); expenditure as outflow (`quranic:root_001537:B002/m01`); passage with an outlet (`quranic:root_001537:B003/m01`); constriction (`quranic:root_001199:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Mercy is pictured as a stored resource only to expose the inadequacy of human custody. Fear treats every release as irreversible loss, so possession tightens into retention; the separate outlet-passage sense makes spending a controlled egress. The channel contrasts a finite hoarder's aperture with mercy's divine source.

parent_channels.name: S5. Whole Surah (17:1-111): The Chance-Arrow Allotment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Marked lots are stored together, a named fifth lot enters the draw, portions of a slaughtered camel are distributed by the arrows, and a losing lot forfeits its claim.
parent_channels.active_motifs: leather case gathering gaming lots (`quranic:root_000532:B010/m01`); fifth maysir lot (`quranic:root_001533:B016/m01`); gambling arrows that divide a slaughtered camel (`quranic:root_001694:B007/m01`); losing lot and forfeited wager (`quranic:root_000458:B019/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The receptacle, named lot, division procedure, and losing outcome form a complete allotment game. This usefully pressures the surah's primary treatment of kin-right, provision, and just measure: claims named in 17:26-35 are assigned obligations, not shares to be left to a favorable draw. The maysir activation under `ميسورا` makes gracious speech during temporary inability the opposite of exposing a claimant to chance.

parent_channels.name: S6. Whole Surah (17:1-111): A Lamp Lit From Flint, Oil, and Wick
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A fire-stone is struck, an emitted spark reaches a twisted wick, and illuminating oil sustains the flame.
parent_channels.active_motifs: struck fire-stone and its scattered matter (`quranic:root_001335:B002/m01`); flying ember from a fire-stone (`quranic:root_000719:B005/m01`); illuminating oil (`quranic:root_000732:B005/m01`); twisted lamp wick (`quranic:root_001127:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Flint, spark, oil, and wick supply a full lighting mechanism. The scene materializes the surah's primary account of signs and guidance as transmission rather than compulsory spectacle: a flash must meet a receptive wick and a sustaining medium before it becomes durable light. That concretely supports 17:59-60 and 17:82-89, where visible evidence discloses the receiver's disposition instead of overriding it.

parent_channels.name: S7. Whole Surah (17:1-111): A Paced Horse Race With a Ranked Finish
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A rider extends the reins for speed, a fit horse places its hind hooves in the fore-hoof track, competitors pace one another, and the second horse follows with its head at the leader's hindquarters.
parent_channels.active_motifs: reins extended to increase speed (`quranic:root_000151:B007/m01`); horse with matched hoof placement (`quranic:root_000347:B014/m01`); horse pacing a competitor (`quranic:root_001335:B004/m01`); runner-up following the leader (`quranic:root_000879:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Reins, fitted stride, matched pace, and relative finish form a complete race rather than a generic motion cluster. It usefully reframes the surah's contrast between haste and fitted striving in 17:18-21: progress is disciplined pace in relation to a course and leader, not acceleration by itself. Because the runner-up branch belongs to the prayer root, the race also materializes scheduled worship as sustained following rather than an isolated burst.

parent_channels.name: S8. Whole Surah (17:1-111): A Hide Prepared to Hold Its Contents
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A hide is flayed and scraped, residual flesh is cleared, a measured tanning treatment is applied, the leather is oiled, and the finished skin becomes a vessel that retains its contents.
parent_channels.active_motifs: scraping and flaying a hide (`quranic:root_001476:B003/m01`); flesh left in a poorly cleaned hide (`quranic:root_001102:B012/m01`); one or two measures of tanning treatment (`quranic:root_001533:B007/m01`); oiling prepared leather (`quranic:root_001412:B005/m01`); skin vessel that holds what is inside (`quranic:root_001424:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The sequence turns perishable skin into reliable custody by removal, measured treatment, and conditioning. It materializes the surah's primary distinction between preservation and hoarding: the final act of holding protects contents for use, whereas 17:100's fearful grasp blocks their release. The scene therefore reframes receptivity and trusteeship as prepared embodied capacity, not enclosure alone.

parent_channels.name: S9. Whole Surah (17:1-111): Milking That Preserves the Next Yield
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A grazing animal's udder fills, milk is drawn, a deliberate remainder is left to call down later milk, and the yield returns in successive flow.
parent_channels.active_motifs: udder filling after pasture (`quranic:root_000810:B003/m01`); full udder (`quranic:root_000555:B007/m01`); milk retained to summon the next yield (`quranic:root_000478:B003/m01`); repeated flow of milk (`quranic:root_000563:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Fullness, drawing, deliberate remainder, and renewed yield form a sustainable milking practice. This supports the primary resource ethic of 17:26-31 by giving bounded retention a concrete function: the remainder exists to sustain future outflow, unlike the hand chained against giving or the hand emptied by total extension. The latent scene sharpens the difference between productive reserve and miserliness.

parent_channels.name: S10. Whole Surah (17:1-111): Burial as Completed Enclosure
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A dead body is wrapped into a shroud, placed on a carrying frame, hidden in the earth, and given the grave as a final house.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wrapping the dead in a shroud (`quranic:root_001365:B001/m01`); bier or carrying frame (`quranic:root_000067:B008/m01`); burial until the body disappears (`quranic:root_000913:B002/m01`); grave as the dead person's house (`quranic:root_000166:B007/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Shrouding, carriage, concealment, and housing form a socially completed burial sequence. This reframes the surah's primary resurrection argument in 17:49-52 and 17:97-99: the summons reverses not only material decay but every human operation that made the body wrapped, removed, and unavailable. Re-creation opens an enclosure that burial had deliberately finished.

parent_channels.name: S11. P1-P4-P5-P6 Bridge: The Reader Becomes Accountable to the Text
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Across distinct textual objects, reading moves from exposure of a personal record, through communal assignment, into a demand for inspectable proof, before delivered recitation reverses scrutiny onto the hearer.
parent_channels.active_motifs: written text as an object (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); reading, reciting, and reading to another (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); orienting exemplar (`quranic:root_000053:B009/m01`); differentiation into parts (`quranic:root_001148:B001/m01`); one voice following another (`quranic:root_000186:B007/m01`); falling in audible response (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge does not make record and revelation interchangeable; it tracks a stable reader-text relation as agency changes. The demanded book is supposed to remain an object before the skeptic, but the personal record assigns liability and the recited revelation elicits bodily judgment or submission. Reading becomes accountable encounter rather than possession of proof.

parent_channels.name: S12. P1-P3-P4-P5 Bridge: The Custodian Role Narrows to Its Sufficient Holder
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The same office is tested through transfer, bounded remit, sufficient performance, and failed substitution until custody can no longer be imagined as a lateral chain of replaceable agents.
parent_channels.active_motifs: surrendering a matter to another (`quranic:root_001681:B001/m01`); competent custodian (`quranic:root_001681:B006/m01`); sufficiency in carrying an undertaking (`quranic:root_001310:B001/m01`); dispatched messenger with a bounded office (`quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`); carrying something away (`quranic:root_000522:B006/m01`); finding an object or agent after loss (`quranic:root_001626:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge distinguishes messenger, substitute, and sufficient custodian instead of collecting them under a protection theme. Delegation cannot enlarge a creature's remit, and the repeated failure to find another `وكيل` closes the imagined chain of replacements. Revelation and servants remain held gifts because custody terminates in its sufficient holder.

parent_channels.name: S13. P3-P4-P6 Bridge: Created Form, Refused Honor, and Re-Created Body
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The patient's material changes from clay to living body to resistant remains, while the maker-operation remains invariant and turns degradation into another occasion of formation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: originating created existence (`quranic:root_000434:B002/m01`); mixed clay material (`quranic:root_000963:B001/m01`); hard bone (`quranic:root_001029:B005/m01`); pulverized remains (`quranic:root_000578:B001/m01`); origination and beginning (`quranic:root_001165:B002/m01`); effective capacity reaching action (`quranic:root_001205:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: P4 supplies the first material operation invoked by the resurrection answers in P3 and P6. Refusal misreads lowly material as a limit on conferred form, while the later objection misreads disintegration as a limit on renewed form. The bridge preserves one maker-patient relation across origin, dishonor, decay, and re-creation.

parent_channels.name: S14. P3-P4-P6 Bridge: Communicative Closure Becomes Judgment Anatomy
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Access closes layer by layer outside and inside the hearer, stabilizes as directional incapacity, and returns as the bodily arrangement of the gathered subject.
parent_channels.active_motifs: screening barrier (`quranic:root_000294:B002/m01`); protective sheath (`quranic:root_001324:B001/m01`); ear as receiving organ (`quranic:root_000022:B001/m01`); heavy auditory load (`quranic:root_001674:B001/m01`); blindness (`quranic:root_001049:B001/m01`); deviation from a course (`quranic:root_000913:B001/m01`); face as oriented surface (`quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`); stopped speech (`quranic:root_000145:B001/m01`); stopped hearing (`quranic:root_000884:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge is causal rather than a list of faculties. P3 shows reception being obstructed, P4 shows obstruction settling into orientation, and P6 externalizes that orientation in the gathered body. Judgment does not add an unrelated disability; it makes the prior communicative closure anatomically visible.

parent_channels.name: S15. P1-P3-P4-P5 Bridge: Harm Tests the Address of the Call
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The call is tested first by discernment, then by the addressee's capacity, then by crisis, and finally by whether restored ease sustains the relation exposed under pressure.
parent_channels.active_motifs: vocal summons (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); injurious evil (`quranic:root_000787:B001/m01`); harm and deficiency (`quranic:root_000907:B001/m01`); uncovering an affliction (`quranic:root_001302:B001/m01`); transforming its state (`quranic:root_000373:B001/m01`); disappearance of a sought support (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); rescue by separation (`quranic:root_001476:B001/m01`); turning the side away (`quranic:root_001001:B005/m01`); severed hope (`quranic:root_001690:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The shared invariant is stable dependence under changing conditions, not distress in general. Harm exposes whether the call can distinguish good, whether its object can act, and whether the caller remains related after rescue. The final turn and despair reveal the same instability from opposite conditions: benefit erases memory, while injury erases hope.

parent_channels.name: S16. P3-P5-P6 Bridge: Revelation Amplifies the Receiver
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A disclosed sign or recitation enters a receiving field and produces growth, but the receiver's disposition determines whether the enlarged outcome is distance, overflow, depletion, or lowliness.
parent_channels.active_motifs: increase and growth (`quranic:root_000657:B001/m01`); reading and recitation (`quranic:root_001210:B002/m01`); recoil and distance (`quranic:root_001532:B001/m01`); assay of person or material (`quranic:root_001128:B001/m01`); overflow beyond a limit (`quranic:root_000937:B001/m01`); healing (`quranic:root_000806:B001/m01`); suffered loss (`quranic:root_000409:B001/m01`); humility (`quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The repeated `increase` operation supplies a controlled comparison across pericopes. Revelation is not inert in any case; it amplifies the relation already taken toward it. Recoil, transgressive overflow, loss, and humility are therefore receiver-specific materializations of one incoming pressure.

parent_channels.name: S17. P4-P6 Bridge: Expulsion Reverses Onto the Expeller
parent_channels.scene_or_process: The later historical case executes the invariant announced earlier: attempted territorial removal transfers instability from the target to the ruler who claimed the land.
parent_channels.active_motifs: destabilizing displacement (`quranic:root_001151:B001/m01`); earth as territory (`quranic:root_000025:B001/m01`); forced exit (`quranic:root_000400:B001/m01`); remaining in place (`quranic:root_001339:B001/m01`); recurrent historical practice (`quranic:root_000750:B001/m01`); engulfing drowning (`quranic:root_001080:B001/m01`); settled dwelling (`quranic:root_000726:B002/m01`); subsequent position (`quranic:root_000131:B002/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: P6 is not merely another displacement story; it supplies a completed instance of P4's messenger-pattern. Pharaoh's attempt to unsettle Israel ends in his removal by water and their settlement on land. Territorial control reverses because tenure is conditional, not because the threatened party overpowers the ruler by the same method.

parent_channels.name: S18. P1-P4-P6 Bridge: Promise Is Distinguished by Enactment
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A spoken commitment either crosses into an appointed event and completed act or remains a glittering expectation without a stable outcome.
parent_channels.active_motifs: promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); promise bounded by appointment (`quranic:root_001662:B003/m01`); deception by an unstable display (`quranic:root_001078:B008/m01`); action brought into occurrence (`quranic:root_001167:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The bridge gives promise an evidentiary criterion without reducing it to speech. P1 and P6 pair `وعد` with action or arrival, while P4 pairs it with a display that cannot stabilize what it projects. Fulfillment distinguishes the source by carrying expectation across the boundary into event.

parent_channels.name: S19. P2-P4-P6 Bridge: Refused Lowering Becomes Imposed Inversion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Vertical posture moves from self-enlargement and refused submission to attempted coercive control, then separates into imposed inversion for closed receivers and chosen prostration for receptive ones.
parent_channels.active_motifs: walking motion (`quranic:root_001427:B001/m01`); joy beyond measure (`quranic:root_001412:B001/m01`); prostrating descent (`quranic:root_000675:B001/m01`); bridling beneath the chin (`quranic:root_000363:B003/m01`); face as oriented surface (`quranic:root_001630:B001/m01`); gathering by driving (`quranic:root_000324:B001/m01`); chin (`quranic:root_000515:B001/m01`); falling in audible motion (`quranic:root_000402:B001/m01`); humility (`quranic:root_000412:B001/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Lowering is not assigned one moral value merely by shape. Refusal and self-height lead toward coercive mastery, while knowledgeable reception chooses the same downward vector as prostration; forced face-down gathering then exposes the opposite relation under an imposed posture. Agency and addressee distinguish humility from inversion.

parent_channels.name: S20. Whole Surah (17:1-111): A Debt Changes Bearers Before Settlement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A claim follows its debtor, a guarantor assumes the liability, the debt is assigned to another bearer, delayed payment draws pursuit, and satisfaction closes the claim.
parent_channels.active_motifs: right that follows its holder (`quranic:root_000186:B004/m01`); guarantor carrying a liability (`quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`); assignment of debt to another (`quranic:root_000373:B010/m01`); delay and pressure in collection (`quranic:root_000483:B006/m01`); payment and receipt of the right (`quranic:root_001237:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene supplies a recognizable legal technology for moving civil liability: guarantee, assignment, collection, and satisfaction. It usefully pressures 17:15 by showing what the verse excludes from moral account. A debt may change bearers through agreed instruments, but no such instrument lets one self assume another's accrued burden.

parent_channels.name: S21. Whole Surah (17:1-111): A Descending Guest Receives the Reserved Portion
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A traveler descends as a guest, the host gathers food for the arrival, and a choice portion kept in reserve is released to honor that guest.
parent_channels.active_motifs: provision and lodging prepared for one who descends (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); gathered food offered to a guest (`quranic:root_001222:B003/m01`); stored choice portion selected for honor (`quranic:root_001247:B005/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Arrival, lodging, meal, and preferential release form a completed hospitality act. This materializes the wayfarer's due in 17:26: the right is not exhausted by an abstract allocation but reaches completion when a displaced person is received, fed, and honored from what the host had preserved.

parent_channels.name: S22. Whole Surah (17:1-111): Birth Through Enclosure and Receiving Hands
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A child grows in the womb, labor brings the child out, a midwife receives the emerging body, the birth membrane follows, and the mother rises from the postpartum condition.
parent_channels.active_motifs: womb as the child's growing enclosure (`quranic:root_000552:B003/m01`); delivery of a child (`quranic:root_001683:B003/m01`); midwife receiving the emerging child (`quranic:root_001198:B007/m01`); membrane emerging with the child (`quranic:root_000373:B008/m01`); recovery from the postpartum state (`quranic:root_001042:B011/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Enclosure, maternal labor, reception, afterbirth, and recovery make dependent life a jointly carried event. The scene materializes both the protected child of 17:31 and the repayment of parental care in 17:23-24: scarcity fear treats the child as an isolated future cost, while birth discloses an existing chain of custody and bodily expenditure.

parent_channels.name: S23. Whole Surah (17:1-111): Convalescence Exposed to Relapse
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Illness intensifies until movement is confined, the patient begins to improve, the fever or disease departs, and a relapse can return the body to a worse state.
parent_channels.active_motifs: intensifying illness (`quranic:root_000151:B008/m01`); illness confining movement (`quranic:root_000192:B004/m01`); first improvement after illness (`quranic:root_001397:B012/m01`); recovery as separation from disease (`quranic:root_001148:B010/m01`); relapse after improvement (`quranic:root_001096:B004/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The sequence distinguishes improvement, release from illness, and durable recovery rather than collapsing them into one label. It materializes the healing of 17:82 and usefully reframes the return pattern of 17:8: mercy can open a real convalescence, yet renewed disorder functions like relapse, making restoration a maintained transition rather than an irreversible status.

parent_channels.name: S24. Whole Surah (17:1-111): Hidden Infection Ripens Into Rupture
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A wound corrupts and spreads, swelling lifts the skin, pus gathers under the boundary, the lesion begins to drain, and its surface finally opens.
parent_channels.active_motifs: wound swelling toward corruption (`quranic:root_000138:B004/m01`); diseased skin lifting from its place (`quranic:root_001532:B005/m01`); pus accumulated in a wound (`quranic:root_000282:B003/m01`); wet discharge from the lesion (`quranic:root_001151:B002/m01`); abscess opening (`quranic:root_000193:B006/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Accumulation under a surface produces pressure, distension, discharge, and visible breach. This materializes the civic ripening of 17:16-17: external ruin is the late rupture of an interior corruption that has already spread and lifted its containing boundary.

parent_channels.name: S25. Whole Surah (17:1-111): Fresh Milk Cultured to a Silent Set
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Freshly drawn milk settles after its foam, a starter culture is poured into it, the liquid thickens and coagulates, and the curd becomes so set that it pours without sound.
parent_channels.active_motifs: fresh milk after drawing and settling (`quranic:root_000860:B012/m01`); starter culture added to fresh milk (`quranic:root_000252:B009/m01`); liquid reaching coagulation (`quranic:root_000067:B005/m01`); thick curd silent when poured (`quranic:root_000884:B020/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Fresh receipt is only the starting state; an introduced agent and elapsed setting transform the whole into stable food. The process supports the surah's contrast between haste and fitted striving in 17:18-19: immediacy cannot substitute for formation, and completion may depend on allowing a transmitted influence to work through its receiver.

parent_channels.name: S26. Whole Surah (17:1-111): An Equipped Arrow Passes Its Mark
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Wood is selected for bow and arrows, a quiver holds small target shafts, a mark is set, and the launched arrow travels beyond it instead of striking.
parent_channels.active_motifs: naba wood used for bows and arrows (`quranic:root_001469:B003/m01`); quiver holding arrows (`quranic:root_001324:B004/m01`); small target arrow (`quranic:root_001199:B006/m01`); target left behind by the shot (`quranic:root_000458:B018/m01`); arrow overshooting its goal (`quranic:root_000651:B003/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene distinguishes equipment, launch, and attainment: a fully prepared shot may still fail by passing beyond the criterion. The arrow sense of `زهق` usefully reframes 17:81. Falsehood does not merely disappear when truth arrives; it is exposed as a trajectory that cannot lodge in the mark it claims to reach.

parent_channels.name: S27. Whole Surah (17:1-111): A Binding Charm and Its Counter-Rite
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A practitioner blows an incantation, directional beads are claimed to bind or turn another's will, and a counter-rite is applied to release the afflicted person.
parent_channels.active_motifs: binding charm that restrains a person (`quranic:root_000018:B004/m01`); bead claimed to turn a heart away (`quranic:root_000860:B009/m01`); bead claimed to turn a face toward another (`quranic:root_001198:B016/m01`); protective incantation with blowing (`quranic:root_000588:B003/m01`); counter-charm removing an affliction (`quranic:root_001503:B008/m01`)
parent_channels.synthesis: Breath, object, claimed redirection, and release form a complete coercive rite. It usefully pressures the accusations of sorcery in 17:47 and 17:101 and the incapacity claim in 17:56: the rite claims to turn a person or remove an affliction, whereas the invoked powers cannot redirect harm and revelation discloses rather than mechanically overrides the receiver's disposition.
